data.title: Dimension 126 Contains Twisted Shapes, Mathematicians Prove
data.author: baruchel
data.article_summary: 文章报道了数学家们证实了在126维空间中存在异常扭曲的形状。这个问题源自65年前关于不同维度中可能存在特殊形状的探讨。研究显示，这些形状无法通过一种称为“手术”的方法转换为普通球体。过去的研究已经确定了这种现象存在于2、6、14、30和62维中，但126维的状态一直未解。最近，Weinan Lin、Guozhen Wang和Zhouli Xu三位数学家证明了126维也属于这一特殊维度。他们的研究结合了计算机计算和理论分析，完成了这一长期未决的数学难题。文章还介绍了背景，包括John Milnor在20世纪50年代对“奇异球体”的发现以及手术技术的引入。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：高维空间中的奇异形状（流形）及其数学意义，特别是126维空间中Kervaire不变量为1的流形的发现，以及其与其他领域（如人工智能、物理学）的潜在联系。

不同观点：
• [kiicia] 认为高维空间中的这些奇异形状与大型语言模型（LLMs）在处理语义空间时的行为有相似之处，尤其是LLMs在多维空间中组织和“解开”意义的方式，虽然这种类比并未得到详细证明。
• [uxhacker] 对高维空间的奇特性质表示兴趣，特别是仅在三维空间中存在打结现象，并将其与LLMs的语义嵌入空间进行联想，质疑是否存在实际联系或只是主观臆测。
• [bee_rider] 对数学家讨论高维空间的方式表示困惑，质疑这种高维概念是否超出了一般人的理解范围。
• [zchrykng] 认为高等数学的证明与现实世界的关联性较小，强调尽管这些数学成就值得尊敬，但其对现实的直接影响尚不明确。

补充讨论：
• [elpocko] 和 [Xmd5a] 对数学中的某些有趣现象（如“数学手术”和打结现象）表达了幽默和调侃，但未深入讨论其数学意义。
• [anthk] 提到高维空间在网络优化问题中的实际应用，如4D超立方体，暗示高等数学在某些实际问题中的价值。
• [ReptileMan] 对自然界中是否存在打结现象提出疑问，探讨数学概念是否与现实世界的物理现象有关。
• [impish9208] 以幽默方式质疑数学论文的实际应用，类似于生物学中的“在老鼠中有效”的说法，暗示对数学成果实际应用的怀疑。

争议的焦点：
• 高等数学证明与现实世界的关联性：[zchrykng] 认为高等数学与现实的联系较弱，而其他人如 [kiicia] 和 [anthk] 则试图寻找其在人工智能和网络优化等领域的潜在应用。
• 高维空间概念的理解：[bee_rider] 对数学家讨论高维空间的方式表示困惑，反映了一般人对这些抽象概念的理解困难。

总体而言，讨论围绕高等数学成就的实际意义及其与其他领域的潜在联系展开，参与者从不同角度提出了各自的见解和疑问。

Dimension 126 Contains Strangely Twisted Shapes, Mathematicians Prove
By
Erica Klarreich
May 5, 2025
A new proof represents the culmination of a 65-year-old story about anomalous shapes in special dimensions.
Comment
Save Article
Read Later
Kristina Armitage/
Quanta Magazine
Introduction
By
Erica Klarreich
Contributing Correspondent
May 5, 2025
View PDF/Print Mode
geometry
mathematics
topology
All topics
It can be tempting to assume that your intuitions about three-dimensional space carry over to higher-dimensional realms. After all, adding another dimension simply creates a new direction to move around in. It doesn’t change the defining features of space: its endlessness and its uniformity.
But different dimensions have decidedly different personalities. In dimensions 8 and 24, it’s possible to
pack balls together
especially tightly. In other dimensions, there are “exotic” spheres that look irremediably crumpled. And dimension 3 is the only one that can contain knots — in any higher dimension, you can untangle a knot even while holding its ends fast.
Now, mathematicians have put the finishing touches on a story of dimensional weirdness that has been 65 years in the making. For many decades, researchers have wanted to know which dimensions can host particularly strange shapes — ones so twisted that they cannot be converted into a sphere through a simple procedure called surgery. The existence of these shapes, mathematicians have shown, is intimately intertwined with fundamental questions in topology about the relationships between spheres of different dimensions.
Over the years, mathematicians found that the twisted shapes exist in dimensions 2, 6, 14, 30 and 62. They also showed that such shapes could not possibly exist in any other dimension — save one. No one could determine the status of dimension 126.
Three mathematicians have now settled this final problem. In a
paper posted online
last December,
Weinan Lin
and
Guozhen Wang
of Fudan University in Shanghai, along with
Zhouli Xu
of the University of California, Los Angeles, proved that 126 is indeed one of the rare dimensions that can host these strangely twisted shapes.
It’s “a very long program, finally finished,” said
Ulrike Tillmann
of the University of Oxford.
The proof, which uses a combination of computer calculations and theoretical insights, is “like a monumental engineering project,” said
Michael Hopkins
of Harvard University. “It’s just jaw-dropping how they did it.”
The Doomsday Hypothesis
In the 1950s, the mathematician
John Milnor
astonished the mathematical world by showing that dimension 7 is
home to “exotic” spheres
. An exotic sphere looks exactly like an ordinary sphere from the perspective of topology, which only considers the features of a shape that don’t change when it is stretched or deformed. But the two spheres have incompatible definitions of smoothness — a curve that’s smooth on an ordinary sphere might not be considered smooth on an exotic sphere. Milnor was eager to explore and classify these exotic spheres, which in some dimensions turned out to be rare and in others numbered in the thousands.
To do this, he
introduced a technique
called surgery, a controlled way to simplify a mathematical shape, or manifold, and potentially convert it into an exotic sphere. The method would become essential to the study of manifolds more generally.
As its name suggests, surgery involves slicing out a piece of a manifold and then sewing in one or more new pieces along the boundary of the cut. You must sew in these new pieces smoothly, without creating sharp corners or edges. (When it comes to questions about twisted shapes, mathematicians also require the surgery to respect the manifold’s “framing,” a technical attribute of how the manifold sits in space.)
To see this process in action, let’s surgically transform a torus (the two-dimensional surface of a doughnut) into a sphere (the two-dimensional surface of a ball):
Samuel Velasco/
Quanta Magazine
The result is an ordinary sphere — in fact, there are no 2D exotic spheres. But in certain dimensions, surgery converts some manifolds into ordinary spheres and others into exotic spheres. And sometimes, there’s yet another possibility: manifolds that can’t be converted into a sphere at all.
To visualize this last scenario, we can again look at a torus, only this time we’ll give it some special twists to obstruct surgeries:
Samuel Velasco/
Quanta Magazine
Mathematicians have proved that there is no surgery that can transform this twisted torus into a sphere, whether regular or exotic. It’s an entirely different class of manifold.

data.title: Why does Switzerland have so many bunkers?
data.author: pseudolus
data.article_summary: 瑞士拥有世界上最多的人均避难所，这些避难所源于1963年通过的法律，要求每个新建住宅建筑包含避难空间或为公共避难所提供资金。瑞士目前有37万个避难所，足以在危机时保护所有居民。这些避难所配有通风系统，可抵御辐射、核污染以及化学和生物武器，平时多用作酒窖、储藏室或桑拿房。2022年俄罗斯入侵乌克兰后，民众对民防措施的兴趣大增，许多人误将历史协会当作民防部门咨询避难所位置。尽管避难所曾被部分人视为不必要，但当前公众态度正在转变。与此同时，其他欧洲国家如挪威和德国也在重新关注民防建设，反映出对战争和人为灾难的担忧加剧。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：欧洲各国的防空洞及其历史、功能和文化差异

不同观点：
• fasouto分享了自己在CERN实习时住在防空洞的经历，指出了作为短期住宿的优缺点，例如缺乏自然光使人容易失去时间感，以及空气过滤系统无法让湿衣服干燥。
• sschueller提到了苏黎世一个被解密的指挥掩体（K85），该掩体通过隧道进入，曾用于紧急情况，现在仍然作为应急通道。

Safe Space
Reporting
Apr 24
Written By
Jessi Jezewska Stevens
Why does Switzerland have so many bunkers?
APRIL 24, 2025
PHOTO: Remains of an old infantry bunker near the barracks (300 m in direction Schöllenen) in Switzerland. (via
Wikimedia
)
At first, Zora Schelbert, chief operating officer and tour guide at the Sonnenberg nuclear bunker in Lucerne, Switzerland, wasn’t sure whether the requests she was receiving were a joke. It was February 2022, and Russia had just dropped the first bombs over Kyiv. “People were asking me what kind of measures they should take, where they would have to have to go,” Schelbert explained. She quickly realized they had confused the historical society she works for, “Unterirdisch Überleben” (“Surviving Underground”), for the local department of civil protection.
To the alternating fascination, bewilderment and envy of its European neighbors, Switzerland, population nearly 9 million, has more bunkers per capita than anywhere else in the world — enough to guarantee shelter space to every single resident in the event of a crisis. (Sweden and Finland are a close second, covering all major cities.) The queries Schelbert was receiving came from frightened people trying to locate their assigned places. Today, however, the Sonnenberg bunker is mostly a museum. Originally built in 1971 to protect up to 20,000 people, it remained one of the largest nuclear shelters in the world until 2002, when its capacity was reduced to 2,000 to improve efficiency and reduce costs.
The exposure to war and man-made disaster feels more acute than it has since any other time since the end of the Cold War.
“Of course I took my replies seriously,” Schelbert said, explaining how she redirected concerned parties toward the appropriate point people. “But yeah, then more emails came in. And phone calls.”
Faced with unrelenting Russian aggression and the simultaneous withdrawal of American military and diplomatic support, European countries across the continent are reinvesting in defense. But
civilian
protection, too — non-military measures for civil defense, including the construction of nuclear and air-raid bunkers — has emerged as a fresh priority. This January, Norway re-introduced a Cold War-era
mandate to build air raid shelters
in all newly constructed residential buildings — a requirement Switzerland has upheld continuously since 1963. In Germany, which recently passed groundbreaking legislation to
finance billions in new military spending
, the question of how and whether to build civilian bunkers is once again
a matter of active public debate
. Partly inspired by efforts in Germany and Norway,
in March of this year
, the European Union issued official statements urging residents to keep an emergency stockpile containing 72 hours’ worth of supplies on hand at all times. The exposure to war and man-made disaster feels more acute than it has since any other time since the end of the Cold War.
In Switzerland, the redoubled interest in civilian protection is more a bellwether for shifting public attitudes than a sign of an actual change in policy. Before 2022, “the shelters were seen by a big part of the population and even some politicians as unnecessary,” said Daniel Jordi, Switzerland’s federal director of civil protection and training. “And this definitely changed.” Silvia Berger, professor of Swiss and contemporary history at the University of Bern and a leading expert on the cultural history of bunkers, confirmed that Russia’s invasion of Ukraine has deeply impacted public perceptions of civil protection: “We’re in the middle of a transformation” of public attitudes “that is not yet finished,” she told me.
Switzerland’s policy to provide shelter to every single resident in the event of a crisis was first enshrined into law in 1963. Every new residential building in Switzerland must either include an on-site bunker, or else developers are required to earmark funds for a nearby public one maintained by the state. As a result, Switzerland is today host to 370,000 bunkers designed to protect civilians underground for anywhere from a few hours to two weeks. Ventilation systems have a shelf life of about 40 years, and neutralize the effects of radiation, nuclear fallout and chemical and biological weapons. The maintenance and construction cost per person, borne largely by developers and property owners, is comparable to annual premiums for Swiss health insurance: Historically, the price per spot is about 1,400 Swiss francs in bunkers with a capacity of 50 to 200, or about 3,000 Swiss francs for smaller ones. In peacetime, most Swiss use them as wine cellars, storage facilities or saunas. In the 1990s, as Cold War tensions relaxed, bunkers even played host to paintball and band practice, or served as community centers.

data.title: Understanding Memory Management, Part 5: Fighting with Rust
data.author: Curiositry
data.article_summary: 这篇文章是关于Rust内存管理的系列文章的第五部分，重点讨论了在Rust中进行复杂操作时需要注意的所有权和借用问题。文章通过一个简单的代码示例展示了在使用`for`循环遍历向量时出现的所有权转移错误。具体来说，Rust在调用`into_iter()`时会获取向量`x`的所有权，导致后续无法再次使用`x`。为了避免这个问题，可以使用对向量`x`的引用，即`&x`。文章还解释了Rust中的语法糖以及不同类型的方法调用（如引用、可变引用和所有权转移），并通过进一步的代码示例展示了如何正确使用这些特性。总的来说，文章深入探讨了Rust中所有权和借用的实际应用，帮助开发者更好地理解和解决相关问题。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Rust语言的内存管理、函数重载、编译器行为以及与其他语言（如Zig、C++、GC语言）的比较。

不同观点：
• **关于函数重载的技术细节**：
   - steveklabnik指出，Rust不支持传统意义上的函数重载，而是通过trait的不同实现来达到类似效果。这避免了潜在的编译器错误，因为可以明确选择正确的实现。

sugar

LONDON — British food delivery firm
Deliveroo
on Tuesday said it has agreed to a takeover offer from American rival DoorDash that values the company at £2.9 billion ($3.9 billion).
Deliveroo, which lets users order hot meals and groceries via an app, said its board agreed to an offer from DoorDash to acquire all issued and to be issued shares in the company for 180 pence a share.
That marks a 44% premium to Deliveroo's closing price on April 4, the last business day prior to DoorDash's initial offer letter.
Deliveroo shares jumped to a
three-year high
last week after the company confirmed it had received a takeover offer from DoorDash.
The transaction values Deliveroo at £2.9 billion on a fully diluted basis, the company said.
DoorDash said that the financial terms of the acquisition were final and would not be increased unless a third party steps in with a rival bid.
"I could not be more excited by the prospect of what DoorDash and Deliveroo will be able to accomplish together. We'll cover more than 40 countries with a combined population of more than 1 billion people, enabling us to provide more local businesses with the tools and technology they need to thrive," said Tony Xu, CEO and Co-founder of DoorDash.
International expansion
The acquisition deal marks an end to Deliveroo's tumultuous ride as a public company.
Once viewed as a British tech darling, Deliveroo saw its shares tank 30% in 2021 in one of the worst trading debuts on the London Stock Exchange. Shares have continued to fall from that point and are down more than 50% from the firm's £3.90 IPO price.
Get a weekly round up of the top tech stories from around the world in your inbox every Friday.
Subscribe
Deliveroo went public at a time when the U.K. was still feeling the impacts of Covid-19 lockdowns, which had boosted the fortunes of various food delivery platforms. Investors questioned the sustainability of that growth in a post-Covid world, and saw intense competition in the market and legal challenges to the gig economy model as key risks for Deliveroo.
For DoorDash, acquiring Deliveroo marks a renewed effort from the American online takeout app to expand its presence overseas. DoorDash acquired Finnish food delivery app Wolt for 7 billion euros ($7.9 billion) in 2022.
More broadly, the food delivery sector has been undergoing consolidation for several years now. Earlier this year, Deliveroo
sold parts
of its Hong Kong unit to Delivery Hero, while
Just East
agreed to be acquired
by investment group Prosus.

data.author: nill0

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Curry-Howard correspondence及其在编程和证明书写中的应用和教学价值

不同观点：
• elikoga认为，将"Propositions as Types"（命题即类型）/ Curry-Howard correspondence应用于教学中，可以帮助学生更好地掌握结构化的证明书写技巧，尤其是在函数式编程教学中。他认为这种方法能够帮助学生更好地处理证明中的蕴涵和量化问题。
• devlovstad从个人经验出发，表示虽然选修的语义与类型课程（涉及Curry-Howard correspondence的概念）对他有很大帮助，特别是在精确书写证明和理解程序执行方面，但这种课程在计算机科学学生中并不受欢迎，尤其是在人工智能热门的情况下。他还提到了一次对Phil Wadler演讲的失望经历。
• indyjo认为Curry-Howard correspondence被过度宣传为对程序员有用，但实际上它的应用范围有限，尤其是在主流编程语言中。他指出，虽然该理论在纯函数式编程语言中有用，但在命令式、状态化、并发等更常见的编程范式中应用难度大。他希望有更多努力将强大的形式化方法引入主流编程语言或开发更实用的编程语言。
• marcusb提供了另一个相关演讲的链接，供进一步了解Curry-Howard correspondence。
• js8推荐了一本关于Curry-Howard correspondence的书，强调了其在逻辑和类型关系方面的解释。
• gitroom表示，虽然在代码中进行正式证明能帮助捕捉错误，但实际操作中往往比直接修复问题更慢。
• aatd86建议进一步探讨集合论及其对类型的解释，以丰富对Curry-Howard correspondence的理解。
• emorning3表示不愿意手动证明代码正确性，而是希望通过逻辑规范自动生成代码，并询问是否有类似Prolog的工具。
• immibis认为Curry-Howard correspondence虽然有趣，但在实际编程中并不特别有用。他指出，很多对应命题的类型和程序并不能带来实际编程中的洞见，类似于将逻辑表达式转换为集合运算，只是符号不同，并无实质性新见解。

补充讨论：
• 讨论中涉及了对Curry-Howard correspondence在教育中的潜在价值的不同看法，有些人认为它对学生有帮助，而另一些人则认为它的实际应用有限。
• 对主流编程语言中引入形式化方法的期望和挑战也被提及，特别是在实用性和接受度方面。
• 一些参与者分享了个人学习经验和对相关资源的推荐，提供了进一步了解该主题的途径。
• 争议的焦点在于Curry-Howard correspondence的实际应用价值，尤其是在编程实践中的效用。

data.title: Design and evaluation of a parrot-to-parrot video-calling system (2023)
data.author: michalpleban
data.article_summary: 研究表明，宠物鹦鹉可以通过视频通话与同类互动，从而获得积极的体验。在美国，约有2000万只宠物鸟可能感到孤独，而这种视频交流为它们提供了社交机会。实验中，15只鹦鹉学会了发起视频通话，并在两个月内进行了147次通话。它们表现出理解对方是真实活鸟，并学到新技能如飞行和发声。鹦鹉们建立了友谊，频繁互call，显示出类似人类社交的互惠关系。虽然视频通话不能完全替代野外社交，但对被圈养的鹦鹉有显著改善作用，尤其是无法进行面对面互动的鸟。不过，研究人员提醒，主人需谨慎监控通话，以防负面反应。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：宠物鸟类的智能行为以及它们与科技产品的互动

不同观点：
• **bArray** 分享了自己的雄性超级鹦鹉能够滑动YouTube视频，选择播放包含鸟类的视频，并提到该鸟还会乞食和表现出对高蛋白食物的强烈需求，甚至会尝试模仿人类 speech。bArray 还提出希望能让鹦鹉通过技术手段与其他鸟类交流。
  
• **Zobat** 提到有人训练鹦鹉通过声音控制笼子的灯光，结果发现鹦鹉希望比人类设定的时间更早关灯，显示出鹦鹉有自己的作息需求。这表明鹦鹉有能力通过技术手段表达自己的意愿。

• **srean** 强调鹦鹉和鸦科鸟类的智力，并推荐阅读相关书籍（如《Alex & Me》），但并未直接回应具体行为，而是从科学和认知角度讨论这些鸟类的智能。

• **duxup** 引述了一位在鹦鹉救助机构工作的人的经验，指出鹦鹉有时像小孩一样，有破坏性倾向，喜欢拆解物品，这与 bArray 的观察部分呼应，尤其是对鹦鹉行为的描述。

• **teddyh** 以幽默的方式提出可以让鹦鹉接管Twitter，间接回应了 bArray 关于鹦鹉使用技术手段交流的想法，但更多是调侃而非实际建议。

• **rwmj** 认为需要开发一个适合鹦鹉使用的输入设备和自动化系统来帮助它们完成交流，这直接回应了 bArray 关于让鹦鹉与其他鸟类交流的愿望。

• **mncharity** 提供了关于鹦鹉认知的最新研究链接，并通过AI搜索展示了与鹦鹉视觉情感分析相关的发展，提供了科学依据，但没有直接讨论具体行为。

• **imglorp** 提出可以建立一个让鸟类能够随时社交的平台，甚至训练一个“鸟类聊天机器人”来与鸟类互动，这进一步扩展了 bArray 关于鹦鹉技术交流的想法。

• **gadders** 分享了自己狗和同事狗在视频通话中互相吠叫的经历，虽然不确定它们是否在传递信息，但这显示了动物之间可能存在某种形式的互动。

• **deadbabe** 提到自己驯养了一只乌鸦，它会通过AI帮助解决简单的任务，这展示了鸦科鸟类的智能，但与 bArray 的鹦鹉经验不同。

• **thimkerbell** 对视频内容表示怀疑，虽然没有详细说明原因，但这引入了对 bArray 所描述行为的真实性和可信度的争议。

• **CalRobert** 关心视频播放客户端是否为开源软件，显示出对技术实现细节的关注，而并非直接讨论鹦鹉的行为。

• **benob** 提出实验中是否使用了镜子或简单录音作为基线，质疑实验设计的严谨性，间接对 bArray 的观察提出了科学上的质疑。

• **TZubiri** 通过与AI助手的对话，探讨了鸟类视觉颜色的问题，并指出鸟类如鹦鹉的视觉系统类似于人类的RGB系统，而狗只有两种颜色锥体，这为鸟类与技术互动提供了科学背景。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点之一是 bArray 描述的鹦鹉行为的真实性和可信度，尤其是 thimkerbell 的怀疑态度和 benob 对实验设计的质疑。
• 另一个讨论点是科技如何帮助鹦鹉实现更多交流和互动，包括 rwmj 提出的输入设备和 imglorp 的“鸟类聊天机器人”设想。
• 对鸟类智能的科学研究和实际观察结果也是讨论的重要部分，srean 和 mncharity 提供了相关文献和研究链接，以支持对鸟类智能的理解。

43903728.article_content:
Ellie, an 11-year-old Goffin’s cockatoo, video chats with a friend.
Matthew Modoono / Northeastern University
When humans are feeling lonely, we can call or video chat with friends and family who live far away. But, scientists asked, what about pet parrots? New research suggests that these chatty creatures may also benefit from virtually connecting with their peers.
Domesticated
parrots
that learned to initiate video chats with other pet parrots had a variety of positive experiences, such as learning new skills, researchers from Northeastern University, the University of Glasgow and MIT report this month in
Proceedings of the 2023 CHI Conference on Human Factors in Computing Systems
.
“She came alive during the calls,” one pet parent said about their bird, according to a Northeastern University
statement
.
The idea for this study was not random:
In the wild
, parrots tend to live in large flocks. But when kept in captivity, such as in people’s homes as pets, these social birds are often on their own. Feeling bored and isolated, they may develop psychological issues and can even resort to self-harming tendencies like plucking out their feathers.
Lonely parrots are unhappy parrots, so researchers set out to find a way for some of the estimated 20 million pet birds living in the United States to connect with each other. They recruited volunteers from Parrot Kindergarten, an online training program for parrot owners and their beloved pets.
Lonely Parrots Flock Together with Video-Calling Technology
Watch on
During the first two weeks of the study, owners taught their birds to ring a bell, then touch an image of another pet parrot on a tablet screen to initiate a video call. In this initial phase, the participating birds made 212 video calls while their owners carefully monitored their behavior. Owners terminated calls as soon as the birds stopped paying attention to the screen and capped their duration at five minutes. Though 18 parrots began the experiment, three dropped out.
Once the birds had learned how to initiate video interactions, the second phase of the experiment could begin. In this “open call” period, the 15 participating birds could make calls freely; they also got to choose which bird to dial up. Over the next two months, pet parrots made 147 deliberate video calls to other birds. Their owners took detailed notes about the calls and recorded more than 1,000 hours of video footage that the researchers analyzed.
For starters, they found that the parrots took advantage of the opportunity to call one another, and they typically stayed on the call for the maximum time allowed during the experiment. They also seemed to understand that another live bird was on the other side of the screen, not a recorded bird, researchers say. Some of the parrots learned new skills from their virtual companions, including flying, foraging and how to make new sounds.
“I was quite surprised at the range of different behaviors,” co-author
Ilyena Hirskyj-Douglas
, an animal-computer interaction researcher at the University of Glasgow, tells the
Guardian
’s Hannah Devlin. “Some would sing, some would play around and go upside down, others would want to show another bird their toys.” Two weak, older macaws, for example, became very close and even called out to one another “Hi! Come here! Hello!” from their respective screens.
The birds forged strong friendships, which researchers measured by how frequently they chose to call the same individual. Parrots who initiated the highest number of video calls also received the most calls, which suggests a “reciprocal dynamic similar to human socialization,” per the statement.
The experiment also brought parrots and humans closer together—on both sides of the screen. Some birds were even reported to have developed attachments to the human caretakers of their virtual friends.
The birds learned some new behaviors while video chatting with their friends.
Matthew Modoono / Northeastern University
Video chatting can’t replace the social interactions that would occur in the wild, but it may be a viable option for improving the lives of parrots that are already in captivity, the researchers note. In addition, it may be beneficial for birds that cannot interact in person. Pet parrots are highly susceptible to a deadly disease called
avian ganglioneuritis
, which can make it dangerous for human owners to plan in-person parrot playdates.
As for other parrot owners, the researchers caution it might not be wise to suddenly begin launching FaceTime or Zoom chats on behalf of their pets. The study involved experienced parrot handlers who had the time and energy to keep tabs on their birds’ behavior—at the first sign of fear, aggression, disinterest or discomfort, they ended the calls. As the study’s authors note in the statement, “unmediated interactions could lead to fear [or] even violence and property damage.”

• **teddyh** 以幽默的方式提出可以让鹦鹉接管Twitter，间接回应了 bArray 关于鹦鹉使用技术手段交流的想法，但更多是调侃而非实际建议。

• **rwmj** 认为需要开发一个适合鹦鹉使用的输入设备和自动化系统来帮助它们完成交流，这直接回应了 bArray 关于让鹦鹉与其他鸟类交流的愿望。

• **mncharity** 提供了关于鹦鹉认知的最新研究链接，并通过AI搜索展示了与鹦鹉视觉情感分析相关的发展，提供了科学依据，但没有直接讨论具体行为。

• **imglorp** 提出可以建立一个让鸟类能够随时社交的平台，甚至训练一个“鸟类聊天机器人”来与鸟类互动，这进一步扩展了 bArray 关于鹦鹉技术交流的想法。

• **gadders** 分享了自己狗和同事狗在视频通话中互相吠叫的经历，虽然不确定它们是否在传递信息，但这显示了动物之间可能存在某种形式的互动。

• **deadbabe** 提到自己驯养了一只乌鸦，它会通过AI帮助解决简单的任务，这展示了鸦科鸟类的智能，但与 bArray 的鹦鹉经验不同。

• **thimkerbell** 对视频内容表示怀疑，虽然没有详细说明原因，但这引入了对 bArray 所描述行为的真实性和可信度的争议。

• **CalRobert** 关心视频播放客户端是否为开源软件，显示出对技术实现细节的关注，而并非直接讨论鹦鹉的行为。

• **benob** 提出实验中是否使用了镜子或简单录音作为基线，质疑实验设计的严谨性，间接对 bArray 的观察提出了科学上的质疑。

• **TZubiri** 通过与AI助手的对话，探讨了鸟类视觉颜色的问题，并指出鸟类如鹦鹉的视觉系统类似于人类的RGB系统，而狗只有两种颜色锥体，这为鸟类与技术互动提供了科学背景。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点之一是 bArray 描述的鹦鹉行为的真实性和可信度，尤其是 thimkerbell 的怀疑态度和 benob 对实验设计的质疑。
• 另一个讨论点是科技如何帮助鹦鹉实现更多交流和互动，包括 rwmj 提出的输入设备和 imglorp 的“鸟类聊天机器人”设想。
• 对鸟类智能的科学研究和实际观察结果也是讨论的重要部分，srean 和 mncharity 提供了相关文献和研究链接，以支持对鸟类智能的理解。

data.title: RK3588 – Implementing a Vectorscope for processing video in real time
data.author: zdw
data.article_summary: 本文介绍了在RK3588平台上实现实时矢量示波器以可视化HDMI输入视频流的色度信息的过程。主要挑战包括从视频帧中高效提取UV（色度）数据并避免影响视频播放性能。通过使用RGA3硬件加速器将RGB帧转换为NV12/NV16格式，减少了色彩空间转换的开销。随后，UV数据被导入OpenGL ES纹理用于进一步处理。为了实时计算UV直方图，作者采用了计算着色器（compute shaders），尽管相关文档稀缺，最终成功实现三段式计算管道。最后，通过借鉴OBS插件的渲染方法，实现了不干扰视频播放的矢量示波器可视化，并成功处理1080p@60视频流。该工作在ROCK 5B开发板上完成，运行定制的Ubuntu系统。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：使用RK3588或Orange Pi 5 Plus作为HDMI分析器或音频提取器的可行性及其实际应用

不同观点：
• 3abiton认为Orange Pi 5 Plus可以通过其两个HDMI输出端口分别输出视频和音频流，并希望将其用作游戏机的"音频提取器"，将输入的HDMI信号分离成视频和音频两部分。他认为利用HDMI输入功能可以实现这一目的，并对该想法表示兴趣。

• kamma4434则关注实时显示矢量示波器（vectorscope）的必要性，质疑是否有必要在每一帧都进行计算和显示。他提出，由于图像帧与帧之间的变化不大，可以每隔几帧计算和显示一次，以减少计算压力，并且认为观众不会注意到这种变化。

补充讨论：
• 3abiton的评论中提到了实际硬件的使用场景（Orange Pi 5 Plus）及其潜在功能（HDMI输入和输出），并具体描述了将其用作音频提取器的设想。

• kamma4434的评论则集中在对实时显示技术需求的探讨，特别是对矢量示波器在实际应用中计算频率的质疑，提出了通过降低计算频率来优化性能的建议。

争议焦点：
• 3abiton对Orange Pi 5 Plus用作音频提取器的可行性持乐观态度，而kamma4434则对实时显示技术（如矢量示波器）的必要性提出质疑，关注计算资源的合理利用。两者的讨论反映了在硬件多功能应用和实时计算需求上的不同关注点。

43871601.article_content:
Following on from my previous
post
covering decoding and rendering HDMI input on the RK3588, I encountered a new requirement: implementing a real-time vectorscope to visualize chrominance information from the video stream. This proved to be a challenging task due to the need for efficient frame processing and rendering without impacting video playback performance.
Extracting UV Data from Video Frames
The challenges to overcome were:
Accessing U and V (chrominance) values for every pixel in the video stream.
For RGB-formatted frames, a costly color space conversion (RGB to YUV) is required.
The processing overhead increases significantly with higher-resolution frames.
To minimize CPU overhead and offload the color space conversion, I utilized
RGA3
, which efficiently converts each RGB frame into NV12 or NV16 format. This step significantly reduces the processing time needed to access UV data.
Once converted, the UV plane needed to be imported into an
OpenGL ES texture
for further processing and visualization. To preserve performance and avoid unnecessary memory copies, the goal was to directly bind the UV data as a texture.
Computing the UV Histogram
The primary processing here
Computing a UV histogram in real time based on pixel data from the video frame.
Normalizing the histogram values so it scales properly regardless of resolution or luminance.
Building a real-time UV histogram from each frame requires scanning and processing a large volume of pixel data efficiently. Traditional OpenGL fragment shaders are not well-suited for this type of arbitrary data accumulation, especially when dealing with high-resolution video.
Given that the
Mali G-610 GPU
is compliant with
OpenGL ES 3.1
, I explored the use of
compute shaders
, a more flexible approach for performing general-purpose GPU (GPGPU) operations like histogram generation.
Compute shaders for OpenGL ES is sparsely documented, and practical usage examples, especially for embedded platforms are limited. As a result, much of the development involved experimentation and iterative debugging, making it feel like a bit of a black art. Finally I managed to chain to together 3 compute shaders each perform one step in the pipeline.
Rendering the Vectorscope Output
The final step involved visualizing the processed chroma data in a way that mirrors a traditional vectorscope. This required overlaying the normalized UV histogram along with reference markers without disrupting video playback.
I drew inspiration from the
OBS monitor plugin
, which includes a vectorscope feature. Its rendering approach informed how I structured the visualization pipeline, particularly around how histogram data is mapped to screen coordinates.
The demo video shows the Vectorscope is capable of processing a 1080p@60 video stream.
Work was carried out on a ROCK 5B board running a tailored Ubuntu image maintained by
Joshua Riek
.

data.title: Memory-safe sudo to become the default in Ubuntu
data.author: jnsgruk
data.article_summary: Ubuntu 25.10将默认采用用Rust编写的sudo-rs，这是传统sudo工具的一个内存安全重实现。此举是Canonical提升系统组件安全性和可维护性的努力之一，Rust能有效减少C语言软件常见的漏洞。sudo-rs由Trifecta Tech基金会开发，作为其"权限边界"计划的一部分，旨在提供内存安全的权限提升方案。为了顺利过渡，sudo-rs团队正完成Milestone 5工作计划，包括支持旧Linux内核和AppArmor配置等功能。Canonical计划在Ubuntu 25.10中默认使用sudo-rs，并在Ubuntu 26.04 LTS中长期支持。此举旨在推动Rust在系统编程中的应用，并改善Ubuntu的安全性。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Ubuntu采用sudo-rs及其相关技术决策的合理性与影响

不同观点：
• **对Ubuntu系统整体现状的批评与质疑**：[bArray]认为Ubuntu在更新、应用状态保存、Gnome窗口管理器等方面存在问题，并且其软件包、驱动和内核版本落后于Debian等发行版。他对Ubuntu的演变方向表示不满，并质疑Rust是否能真正解决应用逻辑错误的问题。此外，他指出sudo-rs的一些功能长期缺失，提供了一个相关的GitHub链接以支持其观点。

• **对sudo设计中安全问题的关注**：[kokada]认为sudo作为一个setuid二进制文件存在更大的安全隐患，因为bug可能导致权限提升。相比之下，[kokada]对systemd-run0这种不依赖setuid的实现更感兴趣，但同时也承认自己不是安全专家。

• **对Ubuntu作为最广泛使用的Linux系统的质疑**：[Gabrys1]质疑Ubuntu是否是最广泛部署的Linux操作系统，认为Android可能更符合这一描述。

• **对Trifecta Tech Foundation工作内容的疑问**：[ndegruchy]指出Trifecta Tech Foundation似乎主要是在将工具迁移到Rust，并质疑他们为什么不进行宣传。

• **对sudo内存安全问题的疑问**：[Rotundo]质疑sudo是否存在内存问题，以及是否因为内存处理不当而出现过故障。

• **对Ubuntu可维护性的质疑**：[johnklos]对Ubuntu的可维护性表示怀疑，认为如果可维护性是指其源代码树，那还说得通，但如果是指操作系统本身，那就说不通了。

• **对sudo-rs和run0的比较**：[bpierre]提出了sudo-rs和run0的比较问题，并提供了一个Hacker News链接以供参考。

• **对采用uutils作为核心工具替代品的建议**：[xvilka]建议Ubuntu采用uutils作为coreutils、findutils、diffutils等的替代品，并提供了一个GitHub链接以支持其建议。

• **对sudo-rs使用体验的分享**：[zamalek]分享了自己使用sudo-rs一年多的经验，指出唯一遇到的问题是`-E`参数不支持，并认为这实际上是一件好事，因为不允许任意环境变量泄露到特权会话中。

• **对doas作为替代方案的推荐**：[dev_l1x_be]认为doas是一个更简单且更好的替代方案。

• **对sudo-rs在其他操作系统中默认使用的说明**：[figomore]指出sudo-rs已经是AerynOS（SerpentOS）的默认工具。

• **对许可证问题的关注**：[rbanffy]关注sudo-rs的许可证不是GPL，并询问其可能的影响。

• **对技术进展的积极评价**：[asmodeuslucifer]对技术进展表示肯定，认为这是一个好消息。

补充讨论：
• **不同技术方案之间的比较和选择**：评论中涉及了sudo-rs、run0、doas等不同技术方案的比较和选择问题，反映出社区对安全性和简单性的不同偏好。

• **对Ubuntu技术决策的广泛质疑和支持**：一些评论对Ubuntu的技术决策提出了广泛质疑，而另一些评论则对具体技术进展表示支持和肯定。

• **对许可证问题的关注**：有评论关注sudo-rs的许可证问题，反映了社区对开源软件许可证的重视。

43903853.article_content:
Memory-safe sudo to become the default in Ubuntu
2025-05-06
Author: Erik Jonkers
sudo-rs
announcement
May 6, 2025
– Ubuntu 25.10 is set to adopt
sudo-rs
by default. Sudo-rs is a memory-safe reimplementation of the widely-used
sudo
utility, written in the Rust programming language.
This move is part of a broader effort by
Canonical
to improve the resilience and maintainability of core system components. Sudo-rs is developed by the
Trifecta Tech Foundation (TTF)
, a nonprofit organization that creates secure, open source building blocks for infrastructure software.
A Memory-Safe Future for Ubuntu
The decision to adopt sudo-rs is in line with Canonical’s commitment to
Carefully But Purposefully
increase the resilience of critical system software, by adopting Rust. Rust is a programming language with strong memory safety guarantees that eliminates many of the vulnerabilities that have historically plagued traditional C-based software.
"I'm delighted to be investing in critical, low-level software utilities. Ubuntu is the most widely deployed Linux operating system, and by choosing to adopt sudo-rs I hope to accelerate the path to wider adoption across the Linux ecosystem".
-- Jon Seager, VP Engineering Ubuntu at Canonical
Sudo-rs is part of the Trifecta Tech Foundation's
Privilege Boundary initiative
, which aims to handle privilege escalation with memory-safe alternatives.
"While no piece of software - in any language - is flawless, we believe the transition to Rust in systems programming is a vital step forward. It is very exciting to see Ubuntu committing to sudo-rs and taking a leading role in moving the needle."
-- Erik Jonkers, Chair of the Trifecta Tech Foundation.
Preparing for Mainstream Adoption by Linux Distributions
To prepare for mainstream adoption, the maintainers of sudo-rs will complete work outlined in the project’s
Milestone 5 workplan
, including:
Coarse-grained shell escape prevention (NOEXEC) on Linux
The ability to control AppArmor profiles
sudoedit
Support for Linux Kernels older than version 5.9, used by Ubuntu 20.04 LTS
Canonical is sponsoring this milestone to make sudo-rs an even better implementation of the
sudo
command. With the above features, more users and system administrators should be able to use sudo-rs without any change to their current workflows.
The maintainers of sudo-rs are sticking to the "less is more" approach: some features of the original sudo will not be implemented in sudo-rs if they serve only highly niche use cases. The maintainers continue their collaboration with Todd Miller, the incumbent
sudo
maintainer for over thirty years, thus indirectly improving original sudo as a by-product of this engagement.
Targeting Ubuntu 25.10
Canonical plans to make sudo-rs the default in Ubuntu 25.10. This will allow time for acceptance testing by end-users and ensure that sudo-rs is battle-tested before its inclusion in the next Long Term Support (LTS) release: Ubuntu 26.04 LTS, which will be supported for a minimum of 12 years. We are looking forward to learning from the community how we can further improve sudo-rs.
About Trifecta Tech Foundation
Trifecta Tech Foundation
is a non-profit and a Public Benefit Organisation (501(c)(3) equivalant) that creates open-source building blocks for critical infrastructure software. Our initiatives Data compression, Time synchronization, Smart grid protocols and Privilege boundary, impact the digital security of millions of people. If you'd like to support our work, please contact us; see
trifectatech.org/support
.
About Canonical
Canonical
, the publisher of
Ubuntu
, provides open source software, security, support and services. Canonical's portfolio covers critical systems, from the smallest devices to the largest clouds, from the kernel to containers, from databases to AI. With customers that include top tech brands, emerging startups, governments and home users, Canonical delivers trusted open source for everyone.
Learn more at
canonical.com
Further Information
sudo-rs Project Page on Trifecta Tech Foundation
sudo-rs GitHub Repository
Carefully but Purposefully Oxidising Ubuntu
For media inquiries, please contact Erik Jonkers, contact@trifectatech.org

data.title: The Inchtuthil Nail Hoard
data.author: Luc
data.article_summary: 1959年，在苏格兰Inchtuthil的罗马军团堡垒发掘中，考古学家在工作坊地下发现了一个包含超过八十万枚铁钉的宝藏，保存状况良好。这些钉子被藏在六英尺深的砾石回填下，大部分仍保持原状。钉子长度从38毫米到372毫米不等，用于建筑和防御塔的建造。发现的大量钉子展示了罗马堡垒建设中所需的大量铁钉。由于铁是可回收的贵重物资，通常在堡垒废弃后会被回收，但Inchtuthil的钉子却被埋藏。堡垒的建设始于83年后的罗马胜利时期，但由于帝国战略调整，于87至90年间被匆忙废弃，导致大量物资未被回收。

43893442.article_content:
Roman iron nails from the Inchtuthil nail hoard
Articles
The Inchtuthil Nail Hoard
4 September 2024
By
Euan Lindsay
In 1959 during excavation of the legionary fortress at Inchtuthil near Dunkeld headed by Sir Ian Richmond, archaeologists uncovered a singularly remarkable haul of a single kind of artefact.
Located in a twelve-foot deep pit below the beaten earth floor of the workshop – the Fabrica- was a remarkable hoard of nails, over eight hundred thousand in number, many in a remarkable state of preservation.
The find, concealed in antiquity beneath six feet of gravel back-fill was lucky by any standard in the days before archaeologists used metal detection or ground penetrating scans and was all the more remarkable as nothing to match the finds sheer quantity in one single deposit had – or has since – been found to rival it.
Figure 1
During the dig, a large “crust” of nails, was uncovered. As this had been subject to dampness in the ground the rusty mass was fused into a fairly unrecognisable mass. Once this was lifted out of the ground however the archaeologists were astounded to unearth the rest of the cache of nails extending below. The crust above had acted as a sacrificial layer absorbing ground and atmospheric moisture leaving the nails below in a remarkable state of preservation. Among the nails were other items of worked iron from the workshops. The haul though was predominantly of nails.
The nails range in size from small nails between thirty-eight and seventy millimetres long up to the massive spikes three hundred and seventy-two millimetres long (Figure 1). The smaller nails would have been used for general joinery work in timber frame buildings like barracks. Larger nails would have been used for clenching mortice joints in larger pieces of timber: rafters and the like.
The most massive nails, extremely rare to be preserved so well would have spiked together the primary timbers of the defensive tower’s frame. Simply driving such nails home would by no means have been a straightforward affair and it is probable the majority of the pilot hole in the timbers would have been drilled with some form of auger bit before the nail was pounded in the last few inches to act like a modern bolt pulling the pieces together.
All nails were handmade at the forge, and we can only marvel at the sheer manpower involved in making these nails. The nails are generally square in section, tapering gently from head to tip. The heads tend to have fairly amorphous shapes where they were beaten out on the anvil compared to the drawn and stamped manufactured products of today (Figure 2).
Finding the occasional nail at Roman sites is not unknown. However, the sheer quantity of the find at Inchtuthil illustrates how many of them were required in the construction of Roman forts. The reason so few are recovered from fort sites is that on abandonment the fort was usually burnt, this being the easiest way once the ashes cooled of allowing the recovery of the iron nails, iron being a valuable recyclable commodity.
Figure 2
So why were there so many nails at Inchtuthil and why were they buried?
Construction of the fortress at Inchtuthil, Ptolemy`s “Victoria”, most probably got underway the year or so after Agricola’s victory over the Caledonians in 83 AD at Mons Graupius. While Agricola might have had a hand in identifying the site for the fortress, it is more probable that it was during the tenure of his successor – Sallustius Lucullus – that the fort was planned.
Dating evidence of coins found at the site and at the other forts along the frontier network the Romans constructed facing the highland massif at this time suggests the outpost’s untimely abandonment as early as 87 AD, certainly no later than 90 AD. The reason behind this change in imperial policy in the highlands of Scotland was due to the withdrawal at this time of one of the four legions which formed the core of Britain’s garrison along with a matching contingent of auxiliary troops. This reorganisation appears to have been caused by a reappraisal of priorities with subsequent unit relocations following a series of sharp reversals of fortunes elsewhere in the empire.
A legionary fortress would have taken several years to complete, the task at Inchtuthil would have been made more difficult due to the logistical complications of supplying many of the construction materials required if they could not be found locally. One such item that could fall into this classification would be raw iron. The Romans normally relied on the pig iron ingots manufactured in foundries elsewhere in the empire and requiring transport from the Roman’s main supply depots some distance to the south.
The fortress appears to have been substantially complete at the time of its abandonment, with only elements such as the Commanding Officers house -The Praetorium- not having been built yet. That work is likely to have dragged on somewhat is suggested by archaeological findings that the defences, o

data.title: Cuttlefish 'talk' with their arms, study reveals
data.author: geox
data.article_summary: 科学家发现乌贼通过独特的腕部动作进行交流，这些被称为“腕波信号”的动作包括“向上”、“侧面”、“翻滚”和“皇冠”四种姿态，每种姿态涉及不同的腕部位置和波动模式，常伴有体色变化。研究显示，这些信号可以通过视觉和水中振动被感知，形成多感官交流系统。乌贼对正放的视频信号反应更强烈，且能区分原始信号和被扰乱的信号。该发现揭示了乌贼复杂的交流方式，可能涉及侧线和平衡囊等感知水运动的器官，为进一步理解海洋无脊椎动物的交流提供了新视角。

43904478.article_content:
ig. 1. Four distinct arm wave signs observed in adult Sepia officinalis (A–D) and juvenile Sepia bandensis (E–H):
“Up” sign (A, E): The most frequently displayed gesture, characterized by upward extension of the first arm pair and outward extension of the fourth pair, while the second and third arm pairs are twisted at the midsection.
“Side” sign (B, F): All arms are rolled to one side of the body, creating a lateral display.
“Roll” sign (C, G): All arms are tucked and rolled beneath the head, altering its shape to highlight the eyes.
“Crown” sign (D, H): Features a rapid “spitting” motion, with arms arranged in a crown-like formation.
Scientists have discovered that cuttlefish use distinct arm movements to communicate with each other, adding another dimension to these already remarkable marine creatures.
Researchers from the École Normale Supérieure in Paris and the Italian Institute of Technology have identified specific arm gestures they’ve named “arm wave signs” that appear to serve as a communication system between cuttlefish. The study, published this month in bioRxiv, reveals that these underwater signals can be perceived both visually and through water vibrations – essentially creating a multi-sensory conversation.
According to the researchers, this newly discovered behavior involves distinct arm movements that follow specific patterns in two cuttlefish species. These arm wave signs involve deliberate, expressive arm undulations that can last several seconds and be combined in various sequences.
The research team, led by Sophie Cohen-Bodénès and Peter Neri, documented these movements over months of observation. They identified four distinct gestures they named “up,” “side,” “roll,” and “crown” signs. Each movement involves different arm positions and undulating motions, often combined with color changes on the cuttlefish’s skin.
What makes this discovery particularly intriguing is that the cuttlefish responded differently to these signals depending on their orientation. When shown videos of other cuttlefish performing these arm waves, the animals were significantly more likely to “wave back” when the video was displayed right-side up versus upside-down – similar to how humans perceive faces and other socially relevant displays.
But perhaps most surprisingly, the researchers found evidence that these arm motions might be perceived not just visually but also through vibrations in the water. Using specially designed playback experiments, they recorded the mechanical waves produced by these arm movements and played them back to test subjects.
The researchers found that these signals work through multiple sensory channels. By using specialized playback experiments, they demonstrated that cuttlefish can perceive these communications both visually and through water movement detection.
The cuttlefish were more responsive to the original recordings compared to versions that were played backward or scrambled – suggesting they could detect meaningful information in these water movements.
This dual-channel communication system might utilize the cuttlefish’s lateral line and statocysts, sensory organs that detect water movement and low-frequency vibrations. These findings suggest an intriguing parallel between cephalopod communication and the audiovisual communication seen in vertebrates – despite evolving independently.
The team points to fascinating evolutionary parallels, suggesting that just as cephalopods independently evolved camera-like eyes similar to vertebrates, their sensory systems for detecting water movement may have evolved to serve communication functions similar to vertebrate hearing.
The exact meaning behind these arm signs remains unclear. The researchers observed them in various contexts – during mating, hunting, defensive situations, and sometimes spontaneously. This suggests the signs might serve multiple purposes depending on the situation.
The discovery opens new avenues for understanding communication in marine invertebrates and adds to our appreciation of cephalopod intelligence. These surprisingly sophisticated “conversations” taking place beneath the waves highlight how much we still have to learn about communication in the animal kingdom.
Looking ahead, the research team hopes to explore how this discovery might provide insights into communication between vastly different animal species, potentially opening new pathways for understanding how diverse creatures interact with their environment.

data.author: macieklamberski
data.article_summary: Feedsmith 是一个强大且快速的 JavaScript 解析和生成工具，支持 RSS、Atom、JSON Feed 和 RDF  feeds，同时支持 Podcast、iTunes、Dublin Core 和 OPML 文件。它提供通用和特定格式的解析器，保持原始 feed 结构，并智能规范化旧版元素。其特点包括对大小写不敏感、高性能、类型安全、树形抖动、良好的跨平台兼容性及全面的测试。支持多种格式和命名空间的解析与生成，如 Atom、Dublin Core、Syndication、Content、iTunes 等。安装通过 npm 进行，使用简便，提供通用和专用解析函数，返回对象包含所有支持的命名空间数据。

Feedsmith
Robust and fast JavaScript parser and generator for RSS, Atom, JSON Feed, and RDF feeds, with support for popular namespaces and OPML files. It provides both universal and format-specific parsers that maintain the original feed structure while offering helpful normalization.
Feedsmith maintains the original feed structure in a clean, object-oriented format. It intelligently normalizes legacy elements, providing you with complete access to all feed data without compromising simplicity.

Fast parsing

data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：智能眼镜在音乐乐谱显示中的应用及其技术实现

不同观点：
• Aidevah认为Lilypond是一个优秀的乐谱排版工具，能够实现可缩放的乐谱显示，但可能难以在智能眼镜上运行。他指出了Lilypond在乐谱排版中的优势，同时也提到了在智能眼镜上应用的困难。

• eitally建议与大型数字乐谱供应商（如Musescore或Music Notes）合作或出售技术。他认为这对于钢琴演奏者是一个有吸引力的应用场景，并提出了集成节拍器和DAW控制等功能的需求。

• mdp2021对项目中使用的硬件和软件选择提出质疑，认为Epson Moverio AR眼镜在规格和价格上都更具优势，且软件架构过于复杂，缺乏竞争力。

• pedalpete分享了个人使用场景，强调了在演奏时无需手动操作的便利性，并建议增加自动滚动和节拍器功能，以提升用户体验。

• floren担心当前的系统显示速度是否足够，指出三秒发送位图可能导致乐谱显示跟不上快速演奏的速度。

• KyleBrandt幽默地提到如果智能眼镜看起来像普通眼镜或时尚墨镜，乐队在舞台上不用乐谱架会更美观。

• analog31指出在某些音乐 genre 中，乐谱通常以PDF形式存在，因此能够适应纸质乐谱的功能会非常有用。

• zharknado简单地对视频和项目表示赞赏。

• theyknowitsxmas幽默地建议给指挥一个按钮代替30个踏板。

• paul7986讨论了Meta Ray Bans智能眼镜的实用性和局限性，认为它们是手机的补充而不是替代品，并对其未来发展持怀疑态度。

• MarcelOlsz简单地表示这对视奏非常有帮助。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点之一是项目中使用的AR眼镜和软件架构的合理性。mdp2021认为有更好的选择，而Aidevah则关注技术实现的难度。
• 用户对智能眼镜的实际应用场景有不同看法，eitally和pedalpete强调了其在音乐演奏中的潜在价值，而paul7986则对其在更广泛市场中的接受度持怀疑态度。
• 功能需求方面，eitally和pedalpete提出了集成节拍器、DAW控制和自动滚动等功能的需求，这些功能可以提升用户体验并增加产品的吸引力。

data.author: vaibhavdubey97
data.article_summary: Plexe是一款通过自然语言描述来构建机器学习模型的工具。用户只需用 plain English 描述所需模型，Plexe 就能通过多智能体架构自动构建并训练模型。它支持多种LLM（大型语言模型）提供商，如OpenAI、Anthropic等，并可通过Ray进行分布式训练以加速模型生成。Plexe还具备自动数据生成和 schema 推断功能，简化了数据准备过程。安装通过 `pip install plexe` 完成，并支持多种安装选项以适应不同需求。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：Plexe项目的优缺点及其应用扩展潜力

不同观点：
• Stiopa：赞赏工作的同时，建议在模型生成过程中增加用户交互，让用户在每一步前确认或修改计划，以提高灵活性。同时，对复杂模型或高级用户的使用场景表示关注。
• Thefourthchime：认为项目创意有趣，但对项目如何解决比大模型本身更独特的问题表示 unclear，希望看到更多这方面的解释。
• Oras：对多方案尝试表示赞同，并关注模型是否能根据数据自行决定创建或微调ML模型，以及是否能检测训练数据的问题。
• Marinr1：表达了对自动化实验和模型训练的兴趣，特别是在GCP环境下的应用，并建议扩展到EDA、模型选择、解释和特征工程等领域。
• Dweinus：虽然认可项目在工作流中的时间节省潜力，但基于2018年autoML的经验，认为项目无法完全自动化ML生命周期，指出数据质量评估和特征设计等难点。
• Fzysingularity：询问项目相比传统建模方法的优势，并建议通过数据集优化提示词以提高性能。
• Gitroom：赞赏项目对传统ML的重视，认为这有助于不失去ML基础。
• Vessenes：对代理组合方法的实用性表示兴趣，询问开发者对smolagent的评价。
• Drlobster：希望项目能成为scikit-learn兼容管道的一部分。
• MarcoDewey：赞赏项目关注传统ML，而非仅限于LLM。
• Srameshc：诚实询问是否能从数据集中获得微调模型。
• Yu3zhou4：分享了自己曾构建的类似项目，表达对Plexe成功的期望。
• Ratatoskrt：基于经验，认为人类和LLM在统计上都可能犯典型错误。
• Revskill：提出从“Attention is all we need”到“Intention is all we need”的期望。

补充讨论：
• 用户交互和灵活性：Stiopa和Thefourthchime强调了用户在模型生成过程中参与和理解的重要性。
• 数据质量和复杂模型：Oras和Dweinus指出了数据质量评估和处理复杂模型或高级用户需求的挑战。
• 项目扩展和兼容性：Marinr1、Drlobster等关注项目的扩展潜力和与其他工具的兼容性。
• 传统ML与LLM的平衡：多位评论者（Gitroom、MarcoDewey、Ratatoskrt）讨论了传统ML和LLM之间的平衡和取舍。

• Revskill：提出从“Attention is all we need”到“Intention is all we need”的期望。

• 用户交互和灵活性：Stiopa和Thefourthchime强调了用户在模型生成过程中参与和理解的重要性。

data.title: Curl: We still have not seen a valid security report done with AI help
data.author: indigodaddy
data.article_summary: Daniel Stenberg, CEO of curl, 表达了对HackerOne平台上大量低质量AI生成的安全报告的不满。他宣布，将要求每个提交报告的人说明是否使用了AI生成报告，并对被认为是AI粗制滥造的报告提交者立即封禁。Stenberg提到，他们尚未看到任何有效的AI辅助安全报告，且这种现象已接近DDoS攻击的程度。他考虑过通过要求提交者支付保证金来提高报告质量，并对AI生成垃圾报告进行过滤。其他用户也提出了类似的担忧和建议，如建立全球黑名单或白名单，以及利用GPT管道处理报告等。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI生成内容对漏洞报告质量和安全研究工作的影响

不同观点：
• **danielvf**：认为当前的LLM（大型语言模型）生成的漏洞报告大多是无效的，且用户会反复使用LLM处理反馈，导致生成更无意义的内容。他质疑人们是否能区分有效信息和垃圾信息，并认为AI工具目前还不能有效用于安全研究。

• **bogwog**：提出恶意使用AI生成大量无效报告可能会成为一种攻击手段，目的是通过DDOS方式掩盖真实漏洞，从而减少被发现的可能性。

• **vessenes**：认为AI正在改变这一领域的经济模式，并提出建立声誉系统以区分高质量报告和垃圾报告。通过给予通过身份验证的用户更多权限，鼓励他们提交有效报告。

• **parliament32**：同意AI生成的报告多为无稽之谈，并指出一些具体例子，如报告中的函数名根本不存在，批评这些报告未经核实。

• **kazinator**：建议对报告者收取可退还的押金，以减少无效报告的数量。如果报告是真实的或诚实错误，押金将退还；如果是无效的，则不退还。

• **rdtsc**：引用报告中的例子，指出报告者在报告中表明自己开放就业，讽刺他们使用AI生成垃圾报告的行为。

• **uludag**：指出LLM在处理代码安全漏洞时，往往会编造不存在的信息，认为这是系统对齐问题，限制了这些工具的有效性。

• **jacksnipe**：批评那些依赖AI工具的人，常常直接引用AI的回复而不加以理解，认为这种行为毫无帮助。

• **meindnoch**：提出简单解决方案，要求报告者在提交安全报告前支付小额押金，如果报告被认为是AI生成的垃圾，则押金归审查者所有。

• **ianbutler**：提出反例，指出其团队使用AI工具成功发现有效漏洞，并认为问题在于使用者背景和工具调校，而非工具本身。

• **prettyblocks**：质疑如果有人使用AI发现了有效安全问题并成功报告，如何判断AI是否参与其中，认为不应简单否定AI的潜力。

补充讨论：
• 对LinkedIn访问的讨论（molticrystal）：提到对替代界面的需求，以避免登录访问LinkedIn内容，并分享了相关帖子内容。

争议焦点：
• AI生成内容对安全研究的影响：一方面认为AI生成大量无效报告，严重干扰正常工作；另一方面认为AI工具若正确使用，可以发现有效漏洞。
• 如何有效筛选和激励高质量报告：提出押金制度、声誉系统等不同解决方案，以应对AI生成垃圾报告的问题。

总结：评论主要围绕AI生成报告的有效性和其对安全研究工作的影响展开讨论，争议点在于如何平衡AI工具的潜力和其带来的问题。

data.title: Is Planet Nine Alone in the Outer System?
data.author: JPLeRouzic
data.article_summary:
文章探讨了假设存在的第九行星及其在太阳系外围的探索潜力。作者引用Robert Browning的名言，引出人类探索太空边界的渴望，并提到目前对太阳引力透镜距离（约550 AU）的探索。尽管这一目标超出当前技术能力，但JPL的团队正在进行相关任务设计。文章指出，寻找如第九行星这样的新目标可能激发更多探索兴趣，尤其是如果它类似于在其他星系中发现的超级地球或迷你海王星。

研究显示，许多恒星系统存在超级地球，这支持了第九行星存在的可能性。其质量预计为地球的10倍以上，半长轴约700 AU。尽管光学调查未能发现，但通过比较IRAS和AKARI卫星23年间的数据，研究团队尝试寻找可能的红外源，以确认第九行星的存在。文章强调，尽管技术挑战大，但发现新行星将极大推动太空探索。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于太阳系外围未知天体的讨论，包括其存在性、性质以及与“第九行星”假说的关系。

不同观点：
• [adrian_b] 认为，许多跨海王星天体的奇异轨道并不能证明现在太阳系外围存在一个巨大的行星。这些轨道异常更可能是过去某个大型天体扰动所致，甚至可能是一颗曾靠近太阳系的恒星引起的。他引用了2024年发表的相关研究支持这一观点。
   
• [Qem] 提出，“第九行星”假说与Lykawka和Mukai提出的独立假说经常被混淆，但实际上是两个不同的假设。Qem猜测最近的发现可能与Lykawka等人的假说更契合，甚至可能存在两个独立的天体共同影响外太阳系的轨道异常。

• [codethief] 指出，引用的科学文章没有提供来源，并提供了相关链接，强调了阅读原始研究的重要性。

• [yellowapple] 关注的是冥王星从行星降级为矮行星的文化影响，并幽默地表示不能将假想的跨冥王星行星称为“行星X”。

• [xhrpost] 从技术角度讨论了使用暗能量相机（DECam）进行后续观测的可能性，并进行了相关计算，以评估该仪器的分辨率是否足以观测到遥远的行星。

• [soufron] 对恒星经过太阳系的 proposed timeline 提出了疑问，表明对adrian_b引用的恒星经过理论的时间线感兴趣。

补充讨论：

Is Planet Nine Alone in the Outer System?
by
Paul Gilster
|
May 6, 2025
|
Outer Solar System
|
2 comments
It was Robert Browning who said “Ah, but a man’s reach should exceed his grasp, or what’s a heaven for?” A rousing thought, but we don’t always know where we should reach. In terms of space exploration, a distant but feasible target is the solar gravitational lens distance beginning around 550 AU. So far the SGL definitely exceeds our grasp, but solid work in mission design by Slava Turyshev and team is ongoing at the Jet Propulsion Laboratory.
Targets need to tantalize, and maybe a target that we hadn’t previously considered is now emerging. Planet Nine, the hypothesized world that may lurk somewhere in our Solar System’s outer reaches, would be such an extraordinary discovery that it would tempt future mission designers in the same way.
This is interesting because right now our deep space targets need to be well defined. I love the idea of
Interstellar Probe
, the craft designed at JHU/APL, but it’s hard to excite the public with the idea of looking back at the heliosphere from the outside (although the science return would be fabulous). Pluto was hard enough to sell to the powers that be, but Allen Stern and team got the job done because they had a whole world that had never been seen up close. Will Planet Nine, if found, turn out to be the destination that some budget-strapped team finds a way to explore?
We have a lot to learn about planetary demographics given that our planet-finding technologies work best for larger worlds closer in to their stars. But a recent microlensing study suggests that as many as one out of every three stars in our galaxy should host a super-Earth in a Jupiter-like orbit (citation below). Microlensing is helpful because it can reveal planets at large distances from their parent stars. Super-Earths appear to be abundant. If it exists, Planet Nine isn’t in a Jovian orbit, but it’s probably smaller than Neptune.
In so many ways this planet makes sense. We’ve found planets like it in innumerable stellar systems. We also know that mechanisms of gravitational slingshotting can push a planet either out of its system entirely or into an entirely new orbit, explaining our prior lack of detection. We’re talking about a planet on the order of a super-Earth or a mini-Neptune, the former larger than our planet but still rocky, the latter smaller than Neptune but gaseous.
Image:
An illustration shows what Planet Nine might look like orbiting far from our Sun. We have found many such worlds around other stars, but finding one in our own backyard is taking time because of its distance and an orbit that is probably well off the ecliptic. Assuming a planet is there at all. Image credit: NASA/Caltech.
The evidence in the orbits of a number of outer system objects points to something perturbing their paths, and seems to implicate something big. Now we have, after years of evidence gathering and debate, at least a possible candidate for this world. In process at
Publications of the Astronomical Society of Australia (PASA)
, although not yet published, the paper digs deep into data from the Infrared Astronomical Satellite as well as AKARI, a Japanese satellite somewhat more sensitive than IRAS and launched in 2006.
The distant Sedna and other similar bodies with unusual orbital characteristics tell us that something has to account for their high eccentricity and inclination, while a number of Kuiper Belt objects seem to be similarly affected, as shown in the orientation of their orbits (described through what is known as the
argument of perihelion
). Computations thus far indicate mass on the order of something equal to or greater than 10 Earth masses, with a semi-major axis of about 700 AU.
Image:
The six most distant known objects in the solar system with orbits exclusively beyond Neptune (magenta) all mysteriously line up in a single direction. Moreover, when viewed in 3-D, the orbits of all these icy little objects are tilted in the same direction, away from the plane of the solar system. PL-Caltech/R. Hurt.
A huge amount of work has gone into this analysis, all ably summarized in the paper, which comes from Terry Long Phan (National Tsing Hua University, Taiwan) and colleagues. Optical surveys have heretofore failed to find this object, but 700 AU is fully 23 times the distance of Neptune from the Sun, far enough out that visible wavelengths need to give way to infrared to find it.
Phan’s team looked for candidate objects in the range of 500 to 700 AU using the two far-infrared surveys mentioned above, which are both all-sky in range but separated by 23 years, making for useful comparisons. The idea was to find an object that moved from an IRAS position to an AKARI position after those 23 years. Assuming the kind of mass and distance they were looking for, they had to remove stars and noisy sources toward galactic center. Narrowing the field to 13 pairings, Phan and his doctoral advisor T
43907586.article_summary:
文章探讨了假设存在的第九行星及其在太阳系外围的探索潜力。作者引用Robert Browning的名言，引出人类探索太空边界的渴望，并提到目前对太阳引力透镜距离（约550 AU）的探索。尽管这一目标超出当前技术能力，但JPL的团队正在进行相关任务设计。文章指出，寻找如第九行星这样的新目标可能激发更多探索兴趣，尤其是如果它类似于在其他星系中发现的超级地球或迷你海王星。

研究显示，许多恒星系统存在超级地球，这支持了第九行星存在的可能性。其质量预计为地球的10倍以上，半长轴约700 AU。尽管光学调查未能发现，但通过比较IRAS和AKARI卫星23年间的数据，研究团队尝试寻找可能的红外源，以确认第九行星的存在。文章强调，尽管技术挑战大，但发现新行星将极大推动太空探索。

data.title: Show HN: Reverse Pac-Man
data.author: Eagle64
data.article_summary:
"Reverse Pac-Man"是一款与经典《吃豆人》玩法相反的游戏。玩家控制幽灵去捕捉Pac-Man，而非传统中Pac-Man吃豆并躲避幽灵。具体操作如下：  
- 红色幽灵（Ghost 1）：使用WASD或ZQSD键控制移动。  
- 青色幽灵（Ghost 2）：使用方向键控制移动。  

游戏通过反转角色控制，带来新的挑战和乐趣。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对一款类似Pac-Man游戏的机制、设计和技术问题的讨论

不同观点：
• [tantalor] 认为游戏中改变方向的机制过于严格，建议允许玩家按住键提前改变方向，而不是在到达路口时才检测按键，这样可以提高游戏的可玩性。
• [kazinator] 支持tantalor的部分观点，指出幽灵只有在遇到路口时才会响应按键，虽然这可能是故意设置的，但仍然让人感到烦恼。

补充讨论：
• [staticman2] 提到了任天堂的“Pac-Man Vs”模式，其中幽灵玩家无法看到完整地图，而Pac-Man玩家通过Game Boy Advanced链接可以看到，这种多玩家机制增加了游戏的趣味性。
• [KennedyHere] 对游戏标题与其实际玩法之间的预期差异提出了幽默的评论，原本期待引导Pac-Man重新排列点，但发现游戏本身很有趣。
• [amadeuspagel] 赞赏游戏中使用不同键位控制两个角色的创意，并建议通过颜色区分说明文字以提升用户体验。
• [pmontra] 表达了对这种创新玩法的赞赏，认为这种设计新颖且具有吸引力。
• [narcindin] 提到了一款十年前类似机制的游戏“swap box turbo”，该游戏也设计了双人玩法并可在单人模式下体验类似的玩法。
• [bentcorner] 推荐了另一款采用双控制机制的游戏“Brothers: A Tale of Two Sons”，并认为其围绕双人控制设计的谜题非常有趣。

技术问题与建议：
• [xnx] 建议增加双摇杆控制器支持，以提升游戏体验，并提供了相关的开发者文档链接。
• [adamiscool8] 对计分机制提出了疑问，认为分数是否应该倒计时，或者玩家是否应尽可能多地引导Pac-Man吃掉更多物品以获得高分。
• [roskelld] 询问开发者是否计划增加能量药丸机制，以给Pac-Man更多对抗幽灵的机会，并指出游戏初期Pac-Man有时会在没有点数的左上角区域绕圈。
• [progforlyfe] 遇到了游戏加载问题，完全无法加载游戏，可能与高流量有关。
• [mtVessel] 遇到了安全连接失败的错误，无法访问游戏页面。

争议焦点：
• 游戏中改变方向的机制是否过于严格，影响了游戏的可玩性。部分玩家（如tantalor和kazinator）认为当前机制过于苛刻，建议改进。

总体来看，讨论涵盖了游戏机制的改进建议、技术问题、以及与其他类似游戏的比较，玩家们对游戏的创新性表示赞赏，但也提出了若干需要优化的地方。

data.title: Free with In-App Purchase is a sham
data.author: ingve
data.article_summary: 本文批评了苹果App Store中“免费+内购”应用程序的误导性标签，指出其定义模糊，容易让消费者混淆。作者认为，苹果所谓的“免费”仅指下载时无需付费，但并未清楚说明使用应用时可能需要的付费内容，导致不同应用的内购范围和限制差异巨大。一些应用甚至在下载后无法使用，除非用户先支付内购费用，而苹果对这种“诱导转换”策略并无明显反对。作者举例说明某款排名靠前的应用存在误导性定价和不透明的取消订阅指引，批评苹果的审核团队未能有效保护消费者。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：应用商店中的“免费+内购”模式及其优缺点

不同观点：
• [hedora的观点] 认为文章中提到的问题源于App Store的筛选不力，而不是“免费+内购”模式本身。他提到自己使用一些免费但包含内购的应用程序，并没有遇到问题。
• [AStoneThrow的观点] 基于Google Play商店的体验，指出“免费+内购”模式在实际使用中可能会变得混乱，尤其是在多个设备和账户之间切换时，容易导致用户对已购买内容的混淆。他还提到，对于不熟悉的应用，用户希望先试用再决定是否购买，而“免费+内购”模式在这种情况下更为合适。同时，他也承认有些开发者可能故意让用户混淆，从而让用户重复付费。
• [dlachausse的观点] 认为“免费+内购”模式利用了消费者的心理，他们更倾向于选择免费的应用，并逐步被引导进行内购消费。虽然一次性付费可能对用户更有利，但这种模式难以与“免费”应用竞争。

补充讨论：
• 一些应用提供两种版本，一个是直接付费的“高级版”，另一个是免费但包含内购的“试用版”，这种双重列表可能会导致用户混淆，尤其是在多个设备和账户之间切换时。
• AStoneThrow提到，某些应用通过辅助应用（如“Supporter”应用）来解锁主应用的高级功能，这种做法虽然解决了某些问题，但也增加了用户的困惑。
• dlachausse指出，消费者往往被“免费”标签吸引，即使最终可能在内购上花费更多，这种心理倾向使得“免费+内购”模式在市场上更具竞争力。

争议焦点：
• “免费+内购”模式是否是必要的，还是由于应用商店机制不完善导致的。
• 用户在使用“免费+内购”模式时，是否因混淆而导致重复付费，这是否是开发者的有意设计。

43907763.article_content:
Free with In-App Purchase is a sham
May 6 2025
A couple of weeks ago I published a blog post about
App Store Curation
. At the end I said:
Apple claims that locking down iOS to the App Store is justified in order to protect consumers from danger. Time and again, however, it's painfully obvious that Apple's so-called "curation" of the App Store is terrible, miserable, incompetent, negligent.
By the way, the app I wrote about,
Virus Protection for Phone
, was removed from the App Store shortly thereafter. Perhaps Apple should pay me to do their job for them. How about a bounty for scams? I'll take, say, 30% of their revenue.
In this blog post, I want to discuss a fundamental, intentional design flaw of the App Store that misleads consumers: the category of apps that are labeled as free with In-App Purchase. The App Store shows an explanation of In-App Purchases when you click the Learn More link in the In-App Purchases section of an app's product page; here's a quote from the first paragraph of Apple's document:
Many of your favorite free and paid apps and games offer in-app purchases, which are optional transactions that change an app's functionality or unlock digital goods, content or services. You can find out if an app offers in-app purchases by visiting its product page in the App Store. Just look for the "In-App Purchases" messages near the Get or Price button.
The problem is that what Apple means here by "free" as opposed to "paid" is simply that you don't have to pay before downloading the app, but Apple's counterintuitive definition tends to obscure what is most important to consumers: how much you have to pay to
use
the app. The range of allowed use can vary drastically among apps that are free with IAP. Some apps can be used forever for free with no apparent limitations, and the IAP merely unlocks bonus content or features. Some can be used for free in "reader" mode, with the ability to open and read documents, while an IAP is required to edit and/or sync documents. Some apps are free to use fully for only a limited time; in other words, they have a time-limited free trial. At the end of the trial, various outcomes are possible. Time-limited trials are especially popular with auto-renewing subscription apps, which start charging you automatically at the end of the trial. And ironically, some so-called "free" apps don't allow any use at all unless you first pay the IAP.
Three years ago,
I highlighted such an app
that was free to download but could not be used in any way without the IAP. In response to the ensuing negative publicity, the developer of the app added a time-limited free trial. Nonetheless, Apple had already approved the app without a free trial, and there's no evidence that Apple or its app review team has any objection to the bait-and-switch tactic. As
Nick Heer wrote at the time:
This is the kind of thing Apple sought to prevent when it launched In-App Purchases as a
feature for paid apps only
. Opening them up to free apps has created different purchasing mechanisms in the App Store and has pushed the industry toward subscription pricing, but it has also enabled scummy behaviour like this.
The app in question is still
in the Mac App Store
, apparently renamed from "Docs Pro for Google Drive" to "Docs for Google Docs and Drive", but still labeled as free with IAP. In fact it's one of the Mac App Store's most financially successful apps, currently ranked #33 top grossing the United States,
according to AppFigures
.
Below is a screenshot of the app's window now on first launch (click to see full size):
You might be shocked to learn that the window is actually
floating
. That is, it floats above and covers every other window on the Mac, even if you switch to a different app. And Apple approved this. You can close the floating window, but that quits the app.
By default, the lifetime $39.99 license is selected. It's labeled "Best choice - no subscription". The 3 day free trial is available only if you select the $19.99 yearly subscription option. The subtitle of the subscription option says, "Only $5.00/month", the math of which is
way
off and would add up to $60 per year if accurate. I don't know how that window got approved by Apple.
To get the free trial, I selected the subscription option.
The instructions for canceling the trial are vague, "in your account". This may be unhelpful or even confusing for novice App Store users, the very people most in need of Apple's protection. Adding to the potential confusion, as soon as you press OK, a new window opens asking you to Sign in to Google with your Google account. (I'll present evidence of customer confusion later in this blog post, in the form of App Store user reviews.)
Fortunately, I did receive a subscription confirmation email from Apple that included a link to my Apple Account subscriptions management page and confirmed the terms of the subscription: "To avoid being charged, you must cancel at least a day before each billing date."
43907763.article_summary: 本文批评了苹果App Store中“免费+内购”应用程序的误导性标签，指出其定义模糊，容易让消费者混淆。作者认为，苹果所谓的“免费”仅指下载时无需付费，但并未清楚说明使用应用时可能需要的付费内容，导致不同应用的内购范围和限制差异巨大。一些应用甚至在下载后无法使用，除非用户先支付内购费用，而苹果对这种“诱导转换”策略并无明显反对。作者举例说明某款排名靠前的应用存在误导性定价和不透明的取消订阅指引，批评苹果的审核团队未能有效保护消费者。
43907763.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：应用商店中的“免费+内购”模式及其优缺点

不同观点：
• [hedora的观点] 认为文章中提到的问题源于App Store的筛选不力，而不是“免费+内购”模式本身。他提到自己使用一些免费但包含内购的应用程序，并没有遇到问题。
• [AStoneThrow的观点] 基于Google Play商店的体验，指出“免费+内购”模式在实际使用中可能会变得混乱，尤其是在多个设备和账户之间切换时，容易导致用户对已购买内容的混淆。他还提到，对于不熟悉的应用，用户希望先试用再决定是否购买，而“免费+内购”模式在这种情况下更为合适。同时，他也承认有些开发者可能故意让用户混淆，从而让用户重复付费。
• [dlachausse的观点] 认为“免费+内购”模式利用了消费者的心理，他们更倾向于选择免费的应用，并逐步被引导进行内购消费。虽然一次性付费可能对用户更有利，但这种模式难以与“免费”应用竞争。

补充讨论：
• 一些应用提供两种版本，一个是直接付费的“高级版”，另一个是免费但包含内购的“试用版”，这种双重列表可能会导致用户混淆，尤其是在多个设备和账户之间切换时。
• AStoneThrow提到，某些应用通过辅助应用（如“Supporter”应用）来解锁主应用的高级功能，这种做法虽然解决了某些问题，但也增加了用户的困惑。
• dlachausse指出，消费者往往被“免费”标签吸引，即使最终可能在内购上花费更多，这种心理倾向使得“免费+内购”模式在市场上更具竞争力。

争议焦点：
• “免费+内购”模式是否是必要的，还是由于应用商店机制不完善导致的。
• 用户在使用“免费+内购”模式时，是否因混淆而导致重复付费，这是否是开发者的有意设计。

data.title: iOS Kindle app now has a ‘get book’ button after changes to App Store rules
data.author: diversion
data.article_summary: Amazon has updated its Kindle iOS app to include a "Get Book" button, allowing users to purchase ebooks directly from the app. This change comes after a recent ruling in the Epic Games v. Apple case, which prevents Apple from collecting a 27% commission on purchases made outside of apps or restricting alternative payment methods. Previously, due to Apple's policies, users had to purchase ebooks through a web browser and then sync them to the app. The new "Get Book" button redirects users to complete purchases via a mobile web browser, streamlining the process. However, if Apple wins its appeal, Amazon may need to revert these changes.
data.comments_summary:

不同观点：

43909432.article_content:
News
Amazon now has a ‘Get book’ button in its iOS Kindle app
Amazon has updated its Kindle iOS app to take advantage of recent changes to Apple’s App Store rules.
Amazon has updated its Kindle iOS app to take advantage of recent changes to Apple’s App Store rules.
by
Andrew Liszewski
May 6, 2025, 1:00 PM UTC
Link
Facebook
Threads
The Kindle iOS mobile app now includes a Get Book button for purchasing ebooks.
Screenshot: Amazon
Andrew Liszewski
is a senior reporter who’s been covering and reviewing the latest gadgets and tech since 2011, but has loved all things electronic since he was a kid.
Following a
ruling on April 30th
by the
Epic Games v. Apple
judge Yvonne Gonzalez Rogers, Apple can no longer collect a 27 percent commission on purchases made outside of apps or restrict how developers can direct users to alternate payment options. Apple has
appealed the decision
, but is also complying with it in the interim, prompting several companies to
announce app updates
making it
easier for users to pay for subscriptions and services
. That now includes Amazon’s iOS Kindle app. Contrary to prior limitations, there is now a prominent orange “Get book” button on Kindle app’s book listings.
“We regularly make improvements to our apps to help ensure we are providing customers the most convenient experience possible,” Amazon spokesperson Tim Gillman told
The Verge
over email. “By selecting ‘Get Book’ within the Kindle for iOS app, customers can now complete their purchase through their mobile web browser.”
Amazon wasn’t the first company to release a dedicated reading device with an E Ink screen. Companies like Sony beat them to the punch by a couple of years. What helped make the Kindle popular, and arguably destined to dominate the e-reader market, was that you could buy books right on the device, even if you didn’t have Wi-Fi access thanks to
Amazon’s now discontinued cellular Whispernet
service.
Before today’s updates, buying books wasn’t a feature you’d find in the Kindle mobile app following app store rule changes Apple implemented in 2011 that required developers to remove links or buttons leading to alternate ways to make purchases. You could
search for books that offered samples
for download, add them to a shopping list, and read titles you already own, but you couldn’t actually buy titles through the Kindle or Amazon app, or even see their prices.
To avoid having to pay Apple’s 30 percent cut of in-app purchases, and the
27 percent tax on alternative payment methods
Apple introduced in January 2024, Amazon previously required you to visit and login to its online store through a device’s web browser to purchase ebooks on your iPhone or iPad, which were then synchronized to the app. It was a cumbersome process compared to the streamlined experience of buying ebooks directly on a Kindle e-reader.
Amazon probably isn’t going to change its mind about avoiding Apple’s 30 percent cut on ebook sales, but the update to the Kindle app now makes it much easier to purchase ebooks on your iPhone for those times when your Kindle e-reader doesn’t have a reliable Wi-Fi connection.
However, there’s still the chance Apple could win its appeal, forcing Amazon to undo these updates and improvements and once again make buying ebooks on iPhones overcomplicated and inconvenient.

data.title: Brush (Bo(u)rn(e) RUsty SHell) a POSIX and Bash-Compatible Shell in Rust
data.author: voxadam
data.article_summary: **Brush** 是一个用 Rust 实现的兼容 POSIX 和 bash 的 shell，支持 Linux 和 macOS，并通过 WSL 在 Windows 上实验性运行。它功能齐全，可作为日常使用的交互式 shell，能执行大多数 sh 和 bash 脚本，但存在一些已知的兼容性限制，如部分 `set` 和 `shopt` 选项未完全实现。目前不建议在生产环境中使用，但欢迎贡献和反馈。安装方式包括通过 `cargo install` 或 Nix、Arch Linux 的 AUR 进行安装。项目采用 MIT 许可，主要通过与现有 shell 对比进行测试，拥有 550+ 个测试案例。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：各种Unix shell的比较与评价，重点讨论了兼容性、性能、实现语言以及许可证问题。

不同观点：
• **POSIX/Bash兼容性重要性**：[chubot]认为OSH是目前最兼容POSIX和bash的shell，并列举了多个理由和测试链接，强调其兼容性与性能优势。而[d4mi3n]和[Pet_Ant]则更关注于探索超越POSIX的shell，如Nushell和Fish，这些shell不追求POSIX兼容性，但提供更结构化的数据处理方式。

• **性能与实现语言**：[chubot]提到OSH使用了一种独特的实现方式，通过"executable spec"和C++加速，性能优于bash。而[ris]则质疑Rust实现的shell在体积上的问题，并提到需要通过多调用二进制文件来解决。

• **许可证问题**：[wiz21c]关注到Rust重写的项目通常使用更宽松的许可证（如MIT），相比GPL许可证的bash，这可能对自由软件社区产生影响。

• **实际使用中的问题**：[Muromec]提到OSH在和fzf脚本配合时存在问题，而[koakuma-chan]则对如何在Windows上运行这些shell存在疑问。

补充讨论：
• **其他Rust实现的shell**：[nbenitezl]推荐了wezterm，一个用Rust写的终端模拟器，而非传统shell。[mystified5016]提到BRASH也是一个Rust实现的shell选项。[shiomiru]提到另一个Rust写的POSIX shell，nsh，但其开发似乎已停滞。

• **个人偏好与使用动机**：[ohroy]表示虽然项目看起来不错，但找不到使用它的理由，反映了一些用户在选择shell时的困惑。[cryptonector]则简单表达了对新项目的喜悦。

争议焦点：
• **POSIX兼容性与创新**：一些用户如[chubot]重视POSIX和bash兼容性，而[d4mi3n]和[Pet_Ant]则认为应该探索更多非POSIX兼容的shell，以利用现代编程语言和数据处理方式的优势。

• **性能与体积的权衡**：[ris]质疑Rust实现的shell在体积上的劣势，而[chubot]则强调其性能优势，这是两种不同的关注点。

• **许可证的选择**：[wiz21c]对Rust项目使用更宽松的许可证表示担忧，认为这可能影响自由软件的自由度。

通过以上分析，可以看到用户在选择和评价shell时，主要关注兼容性、性能、实现语言和许可证等方面的问题，同时也反映出个人偏好和具体使用场景对选择的影响。

brush
About
brush
(
B
o(u)rn(e)
RU
sty
SH
ell) is a
POSIX-
and
bash-
compatible shell,
implemented in Rust. It's built and tested on Linux and macOS, with experimental support on Windows. (Its Linux build is fully supported running on Windows via WSL.)
brush
is functional for interactive use as a daily driver! It can execute most
sh
and
bash
scripts we've
encountered. Known limitations are tracked with filed issues. Out of an abundance of caution,
we wouldn't recommend using it yet in
production
scenarios in case it doesn't behave identically
to your existing stable shell. (If you do find any behavioral differences, though, please report them with an
issue!)
Contributions and feedback of all kinds are welcome! For more guidance, please consult our
contribution guidelines
. For more technical details, please consult the
documentation
in this repo.
This project was originally borne out of curiosity and a desire to learn. We're doing our best to keep that
attitude :).
License
Available for use and distribution under the
MIT license
.
Try it out!
We don't publish binary releases of
brush
, but if you have a working
rust
toolchain installed you can simply run:
cargo install --locked brush-shell
This will install the most recently released version of
brush
from
crates.io
. Alternatively, for the latest and
greatest bits, you can clone this repo and execute
cargo run
.
If you don't have
rust
installed, we recommend installing it via
rustup
.
(If you
are
interested in having a binary release, then please let us know in the 'Discussions' area of this
project or by filing a feature request in 'Issues'.)
If you are a Nix user, you can also use the registered version.
nix run
'
github:NixOS/nixpkgs/nixpkgs-unstable#brush
'
-- --version
Arch Linux users can install
brush
from the AUR
with their
AUR helper
of choice, e.g.
paru -S brush
When you run
brush
, it should look exactly as
bash
would on your system since it processes
.bashrc
and
other usual configuration. If you'd like to customize the look of
brush
to distinguish it from the other shells
installed on your system, then you can also author a
~/.brushrc
file.
Known limitations
There are some known gaps in compatibility. Most notably:
Some
set
and
shopt
options.
The
set
builtin is implemented, as is
set -x
and many frequently used
set
/
shopt
options, but a number aren't fully implemented. For example,
set -e
will execute but its semantics aren't applied across execution.
Anything tagged with a
TODO
comment or where
error::unimp()
is used to return a "not implemented" error
.
These aren't all tracked with GitHub issues right now, but there's a number of these scattered throughout the code base. Some are indicative of missing functionality that may be straightforward to implement; others may be more complicated.
If you feel so inclined, we'd love contributions toward any of the above, with broadening test coverage, deeper compatibility evaluation, or really any other opportunities you can find to help us make this project better.
Testing strategy
This project is primarily tested by comparing its behavior with other existing shells, leveraging the latter as test oracles. The integration tests implemented in this repo include
550+ test cases
run on both this shell and an oracle, comparing standard output and exit codes.
For more details, please consult the
reference documentation on integration testing
.
Credits

- for readline-like input and interactive usage
clap
- command-line parsing, used both by the top-level brush CLI as well as built-in commands
fancy-regex
- relied on for everything regex
tokio
- async, well, everything
nix
rust crate
- higher-level APIs for Unix/POSIX system APIs

43908368.article_summary: **Brush** 是一个用 Rust 实现的兼容 POSIX 和 bash 的 shell，支持 Linux 和 macOS，并通过 WSL 在 Windows 上实验性运行。它功能齐全，可作为日常使用的交互式 shell，能执行大多数 sh 和 bash 脚本，但存在一些已知的兼容性限制，如部分 `set` 和 `shopt` 选项未完全实现。目前不建议在生产环境中使用，但欢迎贡献和反馈。安装方式包括通过 `cargo install` 或 Nix、Arch Linux 的 AUR 进行安装。项目采用 MIT 许可，主要通过与现有 shell 对比进行测试，拥有 550+ 个测试案例。
43908368.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：各种Unix shell的比较与评价，重点讨论了兼容性、性能、实现语言以及许可证问题。

不同观点：
• **POSIX/Bash兼容性重要性**：[chubot]认为OSH是目前最兼容POSIX和bash的shell，并列举了多个理由和测试链接，强调其兼容性与性能优势。而[d4mi3n]和[Pet_Ant]则更关注于探索超越POSIX的shell，如Nushell和Fish，这些shell不追求POSIX兼容性，但提供更结构化的数据处理方式。

• **性能与实现语言**：[chubot]提到OSH使用了一种独特的实现方式，通过"executable spec"和C++加速，性能优于bash。而[ris]则质疑Rust实现的shell在体积上的问题，并提到需要通过多调用二进制文件来解决。

• **许可证问题**：[wiz21c]关注到Rust重写的项目通常使用更宽松的许可证（如MIT），相比GPL许可证的bash，这可能对自由软件社区产生影响。

• **实际使用中的问题**：[Muromec]提到OSH在和fzf脚本配合时存在问题，而[koakuma-chan]则对如何在Windows上运行这些shell存在疑问。

补充讨论：
• **其他Rust实现的shell**：[nbenitezl]推荐了wezterm，一个用Rust写的终端模拟器，而非传统shell。[mystified5016]提到BRASH也是一个Rust实现的shell选项。[shiomiru]提到另一个Rust写的POSIX shell，nsh，但其开发似乎已停滞。

• **个人偏好与使用动机**：[ohroy]表示虽然项目看起来不错，但找不到使用它的理由，反映了一些用户在选择shell时的困惑。[cryptonector]则简单表达了对新项目的喜悦。

争议焦点：
• **POSIX兼容性与创新**：一些用户如[chubot]重视POSIX和bash兼容性，而[d4mi3n]和[Pet_Ant]则认为应该探索更多非POSIX兼容的shell，以利用现代编程语言和数据处理方式的优势。

• **性能与体积的权衡**：[ris]质疑Rust实现的shell在体积上的劣势，而[chubot]则强调其性能优势，这是两种不同的关注点。

• **许可证的选择**：[wiz21c]对Rust项目使用更宽松的许可证表示担忧，认为这可能影响自由软件的自由度。

通过以上分析，可以看到用户在选择和评价shell时，主要关注兼容性、性能、实现语言和许可证等方面的问题，同时也反映出个人偏好和具体使用场景对选择的影响。

data.title: Preparing for when the machine stops
data.author: foxfired
data.article_summary: 这篇文章讨论了软件开发者在职业生涯中从初学到熟练的过程，以及人工智能（AI）的崛起对开发工作的影响。作者描述了从依赖System 2（慢而分析性的学习模式）到System 1（快而直觉的应用模式）的转变，并通过自身经历说明新技术（如Angular、React、Vue等）如何迫使开发者重新学习。然而，AI的出现不仅改变了开发方式，还质疑了学习本身的必要性。作者警告，过度依赖AI可能导致开发者丧失理解和解决问题的能力，并引用E.M. Forster的小说《机器停转》警示人们，如果完全依赖机器，社会将变得脆弱。文章最后强调，学会如何学习和适时抵制自动化带来的便利同样重要，因为当“机器停止”时，我们需要重新学会思考。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：对技术进步、自动化及未来社会系统的思考与担忧

不同观点：
• **对技术依赖的担忧**：
  - strict9、lurk2、metalrain等人认为，随着技术（尤其是AI和自动化）的发展，年轻一代逐渐失去对基础技能和知识的掌握。当系统崩溃时，社会将无法维持，因为没有人知道如何修复这些系统（如The Machine Stops中的情境）。
  - strict9特别指出，技术行业的工作机会减少以及过度依赖AI会导致未来技术系统维护的困难。
  - metalrain强调，如果发生大规模的电子设备损坏（如EMP事件），依赖软件工作的人将失去能力修复或重建技术系统。

• **对技术进步的乐观态度**：
  - hnthrow90348765认为，即便发生大规模技术崩溃，人类可以在相对较短的时间内通过书籍和其他知识来源重建技术能力。并指出，即使经历10年的“黑暗时代”，人类仍然在技术上保持领先。
  - cadamsdotcom反驳了单一崩溃点的担忧，认为人类已经建立了没有单一崩溃点的系统，且AI模型已经多样化，来自不同的文化和国家。

• **对自动化与人类技能的平衡讨论**：
  - gnatolf提出，自动化带来的生产力提升与人类思维能力的下降之间需要找到平衡，担忧过度依赖AI会导致人类直觉和概念理解的丧失。
  - huphreem对“学习如何学习”与“学习如何忘却”的概念感到困惑，特别是如何在自动化时代进行“忘却”。

• **对未来技术与社会结构的设想**：
  - Zigurd预测，未来的AI将能够编写出人类无法设计和验证的复杂软件，这种变化即将到来。
  - jjmarr提到，如果人类要殖民其他星球，需要大量顶尖的半导体制造和设计人才，显示出对高度专业化技能的依赖。

• **对自动化影响的社会评论**：
  - cheschire以历史上的工业化为例，指出大多数人并不需要掌握所有技能（如种植土豆），社会依然能正常运作。
  - emorning3则认为，过度依赖AI的人将会为他们的愚蠢付出代价，不必过于担心他们的命运。

• **对AI恐惧的批评**：
  - Krei-se批评了讨论中对AI的“恐惧贩卖”，认为这是不必要的悲观预测。

补充讨论：
- 讨论中提到了E.M. Forster的短篇小说《The Machine Stops》，作为对未来技术依赖导致社会崩溃的警示故事。
- ChrisMarshallNY指出，长期以来软件开发依赖于外部依赖库（dependencies），AI工具只是这一趋势的延伸，并认为手工艺式的软件开发更有意义。
- readthenotes1希望未来不再依赖于未经证实的“流行科学”概念，表明对AI相关讨论中夸大成分的担忧。

争议焦点：
- 技术依赖是否会导致社会崩溃，特别是当人类失去对技术系统的理解和控制时。
- 自动化带来的生产力提升是否值得以人类思维能力的下降为代价。
- 对AI未来发展的乐观与悲观预测之间的冲突。

43909111.article_content:
For over two decades, I’ve worked as a software developer. At some point along the way, writing JavaScript stopped being something I had to think about, it just happened. Building CRUD apps, managing forms, handling the DOM, these became second nature. I could step into almost any project and instantly start wiring things up. This is what Daniel Kahneman refers to as
System 1 thinking
: fast, intuitive, automatic.
But that ease didn’t come for free. It was built through years of deliberate effort, of debugging endless edge cases, of reading through documentation line by line. That’s
System 2
: slow, analytical, and effortful. It’s what you use when you’re learning something new, when you don’t yet have mental shortcuts to fall back on.
As developers, we constantly shift between these two modes. The longer we work in the field, the more we rely on System 1. Until the ground shifts beneath our feet.
I remember the first time I used Angular 1.0. Coming from the jQuery world, it felt completely foreign. Suddenly, my deep, intuitive knowledge meant little. I had to slow down, re-learn, and question my assumptions. But over time, as I built more Angular apps, it too became second nature. System 2 became System 1.
And then Angular 2.0 dropped. The whole model changed. It wasn’t just an update, it was a paradigm shift. Everything I had internalized had to be re-evaluated.
Now it’s React, Vue, or Svelte. Each framework comes with its own philosophy, patterns, and quirks. When I start working with one, I’m back to Googling everything I type. I’m in System 2 again. But I know the pattern. I’ve been here before. Slowly, it becomes intuitive.
But just as I settle into this new rhythm, AI enters the scene. Not as a new tool, but as a paradigm shift. One that doesn’t just require learning. It questions whether we need to learn at all.
Today, AI can scaffold entire applications, write components, even solve obscure bugs. With tools like GitHub Copilot and ChatGPT, it’s easy to get by without deeply understanding the code you’re deploying. At first, this feels empowering. But there’s a hidden cost.
To understand that cost, think about riding a horse. For centuries, humans relied on horses for transportation. It was a skill everyone needed. Then the automobile came along and replaced the horse. We didn’t lose much, because driving still required
some
form of System 2 engagement. We had to learn, we had to adapt.
But what happens when the car drives itself?
In E.M. Forster’s short story
The Machine Stops
, he paints a future where a vast machine handles every aspect of human life. People live isolated lives, fully dependent on the machine. They don’t know how it works. They only know how to ask it for things. When the machine breaks down, society collapses. No one remembers how to fix it.
This is the danger of bypassing both System 1 and System 2. If we no longer struggle to learn (System 2), and no longer build intuition (System 1), we become entirely dependent on tools we don’t understand. We trade capability for convenience.
In my personal work, I avoid chasing trends. I choose tools that are battle-tested. Tools I can reason about. Sure, at work, I use whatever the job demands. But when I build for myself, I want to understand every line.
Learning to learn is a noble idea. But more important is learning to unlearn, and knowing when to resist the comfort of automation. Because one day, when the machine stops, we’ll need to remember how to think.
