data.title: TeleMessage, used by Trump officials, can access plaintext chat logs
data.author: micahflee
data.article_summary: 文章揭示了TeleMessage公司开发的修改版Signal应用（TM SGNL）存在的严重安全漏洞。该应用被特朗普政府高官使用，但TeleMessage可以访问用户的明文聊天记录。文章详细分析了TM SGNL的Android源代码，指出该应用将聊天记录存档到TeleMessage服务器，使其能够获取明文信息。尽管与官方Signal应用外观和功能相似，但TM SGNL用户在注册时通过官方Signal服务器，而聊天数据却被TeleMessage保存。文章还提到，黑客攻击证实了这些安全问题，TeleMessage服务器存储了Signal、WhatsApp、Telegram等聊天记录的明文副本。参议员Ron Wyden已要求司法部调查此事，认为其对美国国家安全构成威胁。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：针对特朗普官员使用Signal克隆版本的技术分析及其安全性讨论

不同观点：
• [质疑不负责任的网络安全实践] dogman144认为，当这一事件首次曝光时，部分Hacker News（HN）用户声称这是高明的网络安全策略（4D chess），而不是不负责任的网络安全实践。他认为这种观点无论当时还是现在都是错误的，因为这个事件暴露了供应链风险，且如果是故意设计的策略，那也是极其糟糕的执行结果。最终，这种不安全的设置在国家安全领域被利用了。

• [对分析深度的质疑] mmooss指出，在这个HN讨论串中，目前还没有特别实质性的分析，大家对此也无从深入评论。他认为HN的许多评论者不会在快速写下的评论中犯这种错误。

• [批评政府行为] fnordpiglet批评政府试图监禁像Krebs这样诚实的人，认为他们得到了应得的“专家”。

• [实用性问题] proactivesvcs提到，Signal没有提供在任何平台上以明文形式访问聊天记录的功能，这使得备份变得困难。尤其是在桌面端，由于数据库的变化，备份程序需要不断更新，这带来了不便。

• [对安全漏洞的讽刺] aeontech讽刺地表示，与其黑进手机安装键盘记录器，不如说服公司的IT部门直接购买和安装。

• [对潜在风险的担忧] csours和theyknowitsxmas认为，这个事件可能带来潜在的安全风险（footgun），但任何人都可以修改客户端名称并在公开场合误导他人。

• [为特朗普政府辩护] khaky54为特朗普政府使用Signal克隆版本的行为进行辩护，指出这种做法实际上是为了遵守法律和机构政策，并且相关的基础设施是在上届政府期间设置的。他还引用了多个来源和配置说明，证明该系统在理论上是安全的，尤其是对于敏感的政府通信。

补充讨论：
• 争议焦点在于特朗普政府使用Signal克隆版本的意图和安全性。一部分人认为这是不负责任的网络安全实践，而另一部分人则认为这是为了遵守法律和政策的需要，且系统设置在理论上是安全的。

• 讨论中还涉及了具体技术细节，例如消息的加密传输路径，是否经过商业云服务，以及政府部门使用的不同安全等级配置。这些技术细节进一步复杂化了对整个事件的安全性评估。

• 讨论还提到，最初的报道可能带有误导性，将特朗普政府的行为描述为异常或违法，而实际上这种做法可能是前几届政府就开始的标准操作。

43909220.article_content:
Despite their misleading marketing, TeleMessage, the company that makes a modified version of Signal used by senior Trump officials, can access plaintext chat logs from its customers.
In this post I give a high level overview of how the TeleMessage fake Signal app, called TM SGNL, works and why it's so insecure. Then I give a thorough analysis of the source code for TM SGNL's Android app, and what led me to conclude that TeleMessage can access plaintext chat logs. Finally, I back up my analysis with as-of-yet unpublished details about the
hack
of TeleMessage.
But first, here's a quick timeline of events.
On Thursday, 404 Media
reported
that in the Reuters
photo
showing former National Security Advisor and
war criminal
Mike Waltz checking his Signal messages under the table, he was actually using an obscure modified Signal app called TM SGNL, and not the real and actually secure Signal app.
On Friday, I wrote
an analysis
of everything I could find out about TM SGNL using OSINT, including the fact that it's nearly impossible to install without a device enrolled in an MDM service that's tied to an Apple Business Manager or a Google Enterprise account.
On Saturday, after
discovering
that TeleMessage
published
the source code for the TM SGNL apps for Android and iPhone themselves, I
re-published them
on GitHub with the goal of making them easier to research. (It looks like the iOS source code is actually just unmodified Signal, so maybe they actually only published their Android code.)
On Saturday night, an anonymous source told me they hacked TeleMessage.
On Sunday, I, along with Joseph Cox,
published an article
about the hack to 404 Media (and to
my blog
).
On Monday, NBC News
reported
that TeleMessage suspended its service after a
second hacker
breached TeleMessage and "downloaded a large cache of files."
Today, Senator Ron Wyden
published
a letter, which cites the 404 Media article and my analysis of TM SGNL, to Attorney General Pam Bondi, requesting that the Justice Department investigate the "serious threat to U.S. national security posed by TeleMessage, a federal contractor that sold dangerously insecure communications software to the White House and other federal agencies."
The devastating hacks confirm the analysis that I'm sharing in this post: that TeleMessage's server –  hosted on the public AWS cloud, run by an
Israeli company
that's lead by a former IDF spook – has plaintext access to the Signal chat logs they're archiving (along with chat logs for Telegram, WeChat, and WhatsApp).
If you find this interesting,
subscribe
to get these posts emailed directly to your inbox. If you want to support my work, considering becoming a paid supporter.

Tying it all together

Overview
TeleMessage makes modified versions of popular messaging apps, including Signal, WhatsApp, Telegram, and WeChat. The modified Signal app is almost entirely identical to the authentic version of Signal, except it also archives copies of every message to a destination determined by the TeleMessage customer. (Presumably, WhatsApp, Telegram, and WeChat work in the same way, but I have only analyzed the TM SGNL for Android source code.)
The TM SGNL app
TM SGNL is interoperable with Signal. When a TM SGNL user registers a new account, they're registering it with the official Signal server. TM SGNL users can send messages to Signal users and visa versa. If you're a Signal user, you have no way of knowing when you're talking to a TM SGNL user, because the apps are nearly identical and use the same infrastructure.
This is how Mike Waltz could accidentally add The Atlantic editor-in-chief Jeffrey Goldberg to a group chat where they discussed
bombing an apartment building full of civilians
: Waltz was presumably using TM SGNL, and Goldberg was presumably using Signal.
Note that we don't know how long Trump officials have been using TM SGNL. It's possible they've been using it since around Trump's inauguration on January 20. If this is the case, the chat logs for the Signal group where Waltz invited Goldberg will have been collected by TeleMessage. But it's also possible that they only started using TM SGNL
after
Signalgate, maybe as a way to attempt to start complying with record keeping laws. So far, we don't know the timeline. This would be good to get to the bottom of to understand what laws they have already broken.
Anyway, on Mike Waltz's phone – and quite likely, the phones of Pete Hegseth, Marco Rubio, Tulsi Gabbard, JD Vance, and many others, possibly even including Do
43909220.article_summary: 文章揭示了TeleMessage公司开发的修改版Signal应用（TM SGNL）存在的严重安全漏洞。该应用被特朗普政府高官使用，但TeleMessage可以访问用户的明文聊天记录。文章详细分析了TM SGNL的Android源代码，指出该应用将聊天记录存档到TeleMessage服务器，使其能够获取明文信息。尽管与官方Signal应用外观和功能相似，但TM SGNL用户在注册时通过官方Signal服务器，而聊天数据却被TeleMessage保存。文章还提到，黑客攻击证实了这些安全问题，TeleMessage服务器存储了Signal、WhatsApp、Telegram等聊天记录的明文副本。参议员Ron Wyden已要求司法部调查此事，认为其对美国国家安全构成威胁。

data.title: Will supercapacitors come to AI's rescue?
data.author: mfiguiere
data.article_summary: 文章讨论了人工智能（AI）工作负载对电力需求的快速波动可能对电网造成压力，尤其是在需要短时高功率的情况下。为解决这一问题，数据中心正引入超级电容器组。超级电容器能够快速充放电，适合应对AI计算中突发的电力需求高峰，从而减轻对电网的负担。这一方案由西门子能源等公司推动，旨在提升数据中心电力系统的稳定性和效率。文章强调，超级电容器可能成为应对AI电力挑战的关键解决方案。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：如何解决AI工作负载带来的电力需求波动问题，尤其是瞬时能量峰值对电网的影响及相关技术解决方案。

不同观点：
• **提高电压以增加能量密度**：krunck提到通过提高电容的电压来增加能量密度，并引用了能量存储公式E = (CV^2)/2，强调电压对能量存储的重要性。
• **虚拟计算和能源浪费**：tzs担心在无峰值期间进行虚拟计算以平滑需求会导致不必要的能源浪费，并讽刺可能有人结合LLM和加密货币挖掘来利用这种方法。
• **备用电源和电池退化问题**：0cf8612b2e1e提出使用备用电源和电池来应对电力需求，但指出锂电池在快速充放电过程中会退化，不过认为工业设施可以通过适当的冷却和容量管理来减缓退化。
• **GPU负载变化的原因**：blt对AI工作负载中的需求爆发感到困惑，认为AI训练应是持续的小批量处理，而非产生大量能量峰值。
• **使用软件优化运行**：Merrill建议通过软件和网络调整使GPU持续以最佳使用率运行，以避免GPU在计算间隙闲置。

补充讨论：
• **电网承受能力**：Animats质疑大数据中心的负载变化是否真的对电网构成问题，指出其他如电炉和轧机等间歇性负载更大。
• **负载曲线和次级工作负载**：janalsncm好奇这些集群的负载曲线，并建议如果“网络间隙”足够长，可以安排次级工作负载。
• **法律和合同义务**：rini17提到在欧洲，大客户可能有合同义务不对电网造成影响，质疑在美国是否也是如此。
• **冷却技术**：bcoates质疑数据中心是否完全被动冷却，并建议调节压缩机电机可能更便宜。
• **超级电容器和超导体的讨论**：paulkrush和amelius分别提出超级电容器和超导超级电感器作为潜在解决方案，但gitroom对此类技术fix持怀疑态度，认为更多是软件优化问题。

争议焦点：
• **硬件解决方案 vs 软件优化**：一部分评论者如0cf8612b2e1e和bcoates关注硬件层面的解决方案，如电池和冷却技术；而Merrill和WatchDog则认为通过软件调整来优化GPU使用是更直接和经济的途径。
• **电网影响的真实性**：Animats对大数据中心负载变化是否真的对电网构成显著影响持怀疑态度，而rini17则从法律和合同角度讨论了这一问题。

整体上，讨论围绕如何通过技术和管理手段有效应对AI计算中的电力需求波动问题，涉及硬件、软件及法律合规等多方面因素。

data.title: Scientists discover new way to convert corn waste to low-cost sugar for biofuel
data.author: gnabgib
data.article_summary: 科学家们在华盛顿州立大学及合作机构成功测试了一种经济高效的方法，将玉米秸秆等农业废弃物转化为糖，用于生产生物燃料及其他产品。该方法使用基于硫酸铵的碱盐处理玉米秸秆，在温和温度下使纤维素聚合物分解成糖，进而发酵成生物燃料和生物产品，且无需化学品回收。该过程成本低，糖的售价可低至每磅28美分，具有商业竞争力。此技术由美国能源部资助，并将在中试规模上进一步发展。研究成果发表于《Bioresource Technology》。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于利用化学处理从生物质废物中提取糖的经济性和环境影响

不同观点：
• mchannon认为，使用氢氧化钾处理生物质的过程中，可能需要大量的电力输入，尤其是在氯碱工业中生产KOH时。他担心这种方法可能会像玉米乙醇或某些生物柴油一样，虽然声称对环境友好，但实际上依赖大量的电力和石油化学能源输入。如果只是少量使用KOH还可以接受，但目前的做法可能并不环保。

• stevenwoo质疑，如果美国的玉米没有受到大量补贴，这种方法在价格上是否仍具有竞争力。他提到文章中说最终产品将与进口的低成本糖竞争，但未提及在美国国内的情况，指出美国人支付的糖价是全球糖价的两倍，以保护玉米游说团体。

• 0cf8612b2e1e补充说，通过副产品的使用或销售来抵消生产成本，糖的售价可以低至28美分每磅，与进口低成本糖竞争。然而，由于美国对国内糖业的保护，美国人支付的糖价较高。另外，他提出目前还不清楚纤维素的当前用途，比如是否用于动物饲料、覆盖物或填埋，并猜测这些材料可能也有一定的经济价值。

• zuluonezero提到澳大利亚利用甘蔗废料的相关技术，提供了一个不同地区的类似技术案例。

43909124.article_content:
Annually, farmers worldwide produce about 1 billion tons of corn stover — leftover stalks, husks, and leaves. Scientists at WSU and partner institutions successfully tested a new, cost-effective way to turn that waste into sugar for biofuel as well as other useful products. (Photo by Adobe Stock)
RICHLAND, Wash. — Scientists at Washington State University have found a new way to produce sugar from corn stalks and other crop waste, potentially opening a new pathway to sustainable biofuels.
Newly published in
Bioresource Technology
, their experimental process used ammonium sulfite-based alkali salts to convert corn stover — leftover corn stalks, husks, and other residues — into low-cost sugar for production of biofuels and bioproducts, making the process more economically feasible.
“Inexpensive sugar is the key to commercial success for new technologies that make fuels and useful products from renewable biomass,” said Bin Yang, professor at WSU’s
Department of Biological Systems Engineering
and a lead investigator on the study.
Yang and collaborators at the University of Connecticut, the
National Renewable Energy Laboratory
(NREL), the
USDA Forest Products Lab
in Madison, Wisconsin, and Washington University in St. Louis, Missouri, sought a cost-competitive way to efficiently turn cellulosic biomass — residues from corn and other tough, lignin- and cellulose-rich crops — into sugar.
Abundant and cheap, biomass holds great potential as a source of energy and valuable chemicals. But its high cost of processing, due to the difficulties in breaking down complex structural molecules like cellulose and lignin, remains a major challenge.
To unlock the vast potential benefits of this resource, it’s essential to develop new pretreatment technologies that can better break down complex polymers to produce affordable sugars.
Developing new and sustainable fuels and products from biomass, Professor Bin Yang works with members of his lab at WSU Tri-Cities. Yang led research into new, economically feasible production of sugar for biofuels.
In the paper, scientists describe how they developed a process that pretreats corn stover with potassium hydroxide and ammonium sulfite at mild temperatures. The treatment allows enzymes to break down cellulosic polymers into sugar, which can then be fermented into biofuels and bioproducts without the need for chemical recovery.
They calculated that, by offsetting the cost of production through byproduct uses or sales, the resulting sugar could be sold for as low as 28 cents per pound, making it competitive with low-cost imported sugar.
“This patent-pending process produces high-quality fermentable sugar for the biorefinery — the industrial process turning plant matter into fuel — as well as fertilizer that can replenish soil nutrients for farmers,” Yang theorized. “There’s no waste stream.”
The study appears in the July 2025 issue of Bioresource Technology as “
A chemical-recovery-free ammonium sulfite-based alkali pretreatment of corn stover for low-cost sugar production via fertilizer use of waste liquor
.”
The project was funded by the U.S. Department of Energy’s
Bioenergy Technologies Office
.
“In the next phase, we will be advancing our pretreatment technology at a pilot scale,” said Xiaowen Chen, a scientist at NREL and principal investigator on the project.

data.title: ACE-Step: A step towards music generation foundation model
data.author: wertyk
data.article_summary: ACE-Step是一个开源的音乐生成基础模型，旨在克服现有方法在生成速度、音乐连贯性和可控性方面的不足。它结合了扩散生成模型与Sana的深度压缩自动编码器（DCAE）以及轻量级线性Transformer，实现了快速且高质量的音乐生成。该模型能够在A100 GPU上20秒内生成4分钟的音乐，比基于LLM的模型快15倍，同时保持较高的音乐连贯性和歌词对齐。ACE-Step支持多种音乐风格、19种语言以及多种乐器和声乐技巧，并提供诸如声音克隆、歌词编辑、混音和音轨生成等高级控制功能。其目标是成为音乐AI的基石模型，类似于图像生成领域的Stable Diffusion。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：AI在音乐创作中的应用及其潜力和局限

不同观点：
• everdrive认为AI应该尽可能地破坏和重建一切，包括音乐，并且认为技术开发者无需对大众如何使用技术负责。这种观点带有一种技术决定论和商业利益优先的态度。
• Rodeoclash作为音乐人，期待AI能作为辅助工具，帮助填充和完善音乐作品，而不是完全生成整首歌曲。他提到AI在音效调整和MIDI生成方面的潜力，但对其在歌唱合成上的表现有所保留。
• 999900000999提到AI在特定音乐类型（如说唱）生成中的表现，指出AI在表达多样性和避免冒犯方面的局限，认为这限制了AI作为艺术创作工具的潜力。
• Semaphor对AI生成音乐的期望与实际结果不符，指出AI在生成特定音乐风格（如黑金属）时表现不佳，结果过于普通和泛化。
• briga关注AI音乐模型的训练数据来源，指出讨论中缺乏对数据收集和使用细节的透明度。
• l72希望AI能作为乐器演奏的辅助工具，而不是歌曲生成的主体，表达了对多样化音乐表现形式的期待。
• gitroom对AI在艺术创作中过于保守表示担忧，认为这可能限制了艺术的创新和发展。
• Alex_001对AI模型在音乐结构和整体 coherence上的表现提出疑问，比较了不同AI音乐生成工具的性能。
• montag对实验部分表示兴趣，引用了一个实验片段。
• architectonic比较了不同AI音乐生成工具的质量和提示 adherence。
• lilcrise关注AI音乐生成工具在小型VPS服务器上的运行可行性。
• dheera对AI音乐生成过程中的技术细节和模型架构提出详细问题，希望有更清晰的图示和解释。

• frankfrank13简单表示对工具的玩耍性感到有趣。

补充讨论：
• AI在音乐创作中的角色：是从属工具还是主创作工具。
• AI生成音乐的多样性和避免冒犯的平衡。

争议焦点：
• AI生成音乐是否应完全取代人类创作，还是应作为辅助工具。
• AI在艺术创作中如何平衡创新和避免冒犯。

🏗️ Architecture
📝 Abstract
We introduce ACE-Step, a novel open-source foundation model for music generation that overcomes key limitations of existing approaches and achieves state-of-the-art performance through a holistic architectural design. Current methods face inherent trade-offs between generation speed, musical coherence, and controllability. For instance, LLM-based models (e.g., Yue, SongGen) excel at lyric alignment but suffer from slow inference and structural artifacts. Diffusion models (e.g., DiffRhythm), on the other hand, enable faster synthesis but often lack long-range structural coherence.
ACE-Step bridges this gap by integrating diffusion-based generation with Sana’s Deep Compression AutoEncoder (DCAE) and a lightweight linear transformer. It further leverages MERT and m-hubert to align semantic representations (REPA) during training, enabling rapid convergence. As a result, our model synthesizes up to 4 minutes of music in just 20 seconds on an A100 GPU—15× faster than LLM-based baselines—while achieving superior musical coherence and lyric alignment across melody, harmony, and rhythm metrics. Moreover, ACE-Step preserves fine-grained acoustic details, enabling advanced control mechanisms such as voice cloning, lyric editing, remixing, and track generation (e.g., lyric2vocal, singing2accompaniment).
Rather than building yet another end-to-end text-to-music pipeline, our vision is to establish a foundation model for music AI: a fast, general-purpose, efficient yet flexible architecture that makes it easy to train sub-tasks on top of it. This paves the way for developing powerful tools that seamlessly integrate into the creative workflows of music artists, producers, and content creators. In short, we aim to build the Stable Diffusion moment for music.
✨ Features
🎯 Baseline Quality
🌈 Diverse Styles & Genres
🎸 Supports all mainstream music styles with various description formats including short tags, descriptive text, or use-case scenarios
🎷 Capable of generating music across different genres with appropriate instrumentation and style
🌍 Multiple Languages
🗣️ Supports 19 languages with top 10 well-performing languages including:
🇺🇸 English, 🇨🇳 Chinese, 🇷🇺 Russian, 🇪🇸 Spanish, 🇯🇵 Japanese, 🇩🇪 German, 🇫🇷 French, 🇵🇹 Portuguese, 🇮🇹 Italian, 🇰🇷 Korean
⚠️
Due to data imbalance, less common languages may underperform
🎻 Instrumental Styles
🎹 Supports various instrumental music generation across different genres and styles
🎺 Capable of producing realistic instrumental tracks with appropriate timbre and expression for each instrument
🎼 Can generate complex arrangements with multiple instruments while maintaining musical coherence
🎤 Vocal Techniques
🎙️ Capable of rendering various vocal styles and techniques with good quality
🗣️ Supports different vocal expressions including various singing techniques and styles
🎛️ Controllability
🔄 Variations Generation
⚙️ Implemented using training-free, inference-time optimization techniques
🌊 Flow-matching model generates initial noise, then uses trigFlow's noise formula to add additional Gaussian noise
🎚️ Adjustable mixing ratio between original initial noise and new Gaussian noise to control variation degree
🎨 Repainting
🖌️ Implemented by adding noise to the target audio input and applying mask constraints during the ODE process
🔍 When input conditions change from the original generation, only specific aspects can be modified while preserving the rest
🔀 Can be combined with Variations Generation techniques to create localized variations in style, lyrics, or vocals

data.title: Transform DOCX into LLM-ready data
data.author: sergiishcherbak
data.article_summary: ContextGem的DocxConverter工具能够将DOCX文件转换为LLM（大语言模型）可用的ContextGem文档对象，提取包括错位表格、注释、脚注、文本框、页眉/页脚和嵌入图片等其他开源工具常忽略的信息。该转换器通过自定义的本地处理方式直接解析Word XML，无需外部依赖，并保留文档结构及丰富的元数据以增强LLM分析效果。转换过程提取文本、段落、标题、列表、表格、页眉/页脚、脚注、注释、文本框和图片等元素，并提供选项控制是否包含特定内容。尽管该工具不处理字符级样式和某些复杂内容（如嵌套表格和图表），但它专为解决常见DOCX处理库的不足而设计，确保提取的文档内容及其上下文关系完整。

DOCX Converter
Contents
DOCX Converter
#
ContextGem provides built-in converter to easily transform DOCX files into LLM-ready ContextGem document objects.
📑 Extracts information that other open-source tools often do not capture: misaligned tables, comments, footnotes, textboxes, headers/footers, and embedded images
🧩 Preserves document structure with rich metadata for improved LLM analysis
🛠️ Custom native converter that directly processes Word XML with zero external dependencies
🚀 Usage
#
# Using ContextGem's DocxConverter
from
contextgem
import
DocxConverter
converter
=
DocxConverter
()
# Convert a DOCX file to an LLM-ready ContextGem Document
# from path
document
=
converter
.
convert
(
"path/to/document.docx"
)
# or from file object
with
open
(
"path/to/document.docx"
,
"rb"
)
as
docx_file_object
:
document
=
converter
.
convert
(
docx_file_object
)
# You can also use it as a standalone text extractor
docx_text
=
converter
.
convert_to_text_format
(
"path/to/document.docx"
,
output_format
=
"markdown"
,
# or "raw"
)
🔄 Conversion Process
#
The
DocxConverter
performs the following operations when converting a DOCX file to a ContextGem Document:
Elements
Extraction Details
Text
Extracts the full document text as either raw text or markdown format (controlled by
raw_text_to_md
parameter)
Paragraphs
Extracts
Paragraph
objects with rich metadata serving as additional context for LLM (e.g.,
“Style: Normal, Table: 3, Row: 1, Column: 3, Table Cell”
)
Headings
Preserves heading levels and formats as markdown headings when in markdown mode
Lists
Maintains list hierarchy, numbering, and formatting with proper indentation and list type information
Tables
Preserves table structure and formats tables in markdown mode (can be excluded using
include_tables=False
)
Headers & Footers
Captures document headers and footers with appropriate metadata (can be excluded using
include_headers=False
and
include_footers=False
)
Footnotes
Extracts footnotes with references and preserves connection to original text (can be excluded using
include_footnotes=False
)
Comments
Preserves document comments with author information and timestamps (can be excluded using
include_comments=False
)
Text Boxes
Extracts text from various text box formats (can be excluded using
include_textboxes=False
)
Images
Extracts embedded images and converts them to
Image
objects for further processing with vision models (can be excluded using
include_images=False
)
💥 Beyond Standard Libraries
#
Our evaluation of popular open-source DOCX processing libraries revealed critical limitations: most packages either omit important elements (e.g. comments, textboxes, or embedded images), fail to handle complex structures (such as inconsistently formatted tables), or cannot extract paragraphs with the rich metadata needed for LLM processing.
While it would have been much easier to use an existing open-source package as a dependency, these limitations compelled us to build a custom solution. The
DocxConverter
was developed specifically to address these gaps, ensuring extraction of the most commonly occurring DOCX elements with their contextual relationships preserved.
ℹ️ Current Limitations
#
DocxConverter has the following limitations, some of which are intentional:
Character-level styling (e.g., bold, underline, italics, strikethrough) is
intentionally skipped
to ensure proper matching of processed paragraphs and sentences in the DOCX content.
Nested tables are preserved but may lead to table cell duplication.
Consecutive textboxes are preserved but may lead to textbox content duplication.
Drawings such as charts are skipped as it is challenging to represent them in text format.
Contents

data.title: GenAI-Accelerated TLA+ Challenge
data.author: lemmster
data.article_summary: TLA+基金会与NVIDIA合作，推出GenAI-accelerated TLA+挑战赛，征集结合TLA+和生成式AI的创新方案。参赛者需开发工程化解决方案，提升TLA+形式化规范的可用性、可访问性和自动化。奖项包括Nvidia GeForce RTX 5090（一等奖）、Github Copilot Pro+一年订阅（二等奖）和Github Copilot Pro一年订阅（三等奖）。示例项目包括TLA+规范智能重构、LLM增强的开发工具、自动化评分工具、规范可视化等。评审由TLA+规范语言委员会负责，基于功能性、相关性和AI使用情况进行评估。参赛作品需可复现，并以MIT许可证发布，AI模型需公开。参赛者需曾参与TLA+社区活动，且不受法律或合同限制。提交截止日期为2025年7月3日，结果将于一个月后公布。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：使用LLM（大型语言模型）生成正式规格说明（formal specs）或形式化建模的可行性及价值

不同观点：
• [Taikonerd] 支持使用LLM生成正式规格说明。他认为LLM可以将非正式的英文规格说明自动转化为正式的规格语言（如TLA+、Dafny等），从而利用现有的自动化证明工具生态系统。他设想了一个场景：人类开发者提供一个非正式的需求，LLM根据该需求和代码库的知识生成正式规格，然后现有的代码分析工具可以验证或找出反例。

• [max_] 对使用LLM生成TLA+代码持批评态度。他引用了Leslie Lamport的观点，认为TLA+是为了帮助人们“超越代码思考”，提升对系统的思考和描述能力。他认为LLM生成TLA+代码只是“智力自慰”，虽然可能完成工作，但对智力和理解没有帮助。他建议如果不认真思考，还不如不写TLA+。

• [kelseyfrog] 持有趣和探索的态度。他提到自己一直想将美国宪法形式化为TLA+，以发现其中的漏洞，显示出对形式化方法应用于非传统领域的兴趣。

• [frogmeister57] 强烈反对使用生成式聊天机器人来编写正式规格说明。他认为规格说明的核心在于推理，需要人类进行思考来简化和模型化系统。他认为正式方法和生成式方法在可靠性上是对立的，称这种做法是对理性的侮辱，建议不要将这种“ nonsense”引入计算机科学的严肃部分。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于LLM是否能够真正提升正式规格说明的编写效率和质量，以及这种方法是否会影响开发者的思考能力和对系统的理解。
• [max_] 和 [frogmeister57] 都对LLM在正式方法中的应用持怀疑态度，但 [max_] 更关注智力提升，而 [frogmeister57] 更强调可靠性和严肃性。
• [kelseyfrog] 的评论则展示了对形式化方法应用的创造性思考，尽管并未直接支持或反对使用LLM。

43907850.article_content:
GenAI-accelerated TLA+ challenge
The TLA+ Foundation, in collaboration with
NVIDIA
, is pleased to announce the
GenAI-accelerated TLA+
challenge—an open call for submissions that explore the intersection of TLA+ and generative AI.
This initiative aims to foster practical and innovative tooling, workflows, and approaches that bring the capabilities of generative AI and LLMs to TLA+. Participants are invited to develop engineering-oriented solutions that advance the usability, accessibility, and automation of formal specification through the integration of GenAI.
Awards
1st Place
:
Nvidia GeForce RTX 5090
(sponsored by NVIDIA)
2nd Place
: One-year single seat, individual subscription to
Github Copilot Pro+
(sponsored by the TLA+ Foundation)
3rd Place
: One-year single seat, individual subscription to
Github Copilot Pro
(sponsored by the TLA+ Foundation)
Example Project Areas
Participants may submit work including, but not limited to:
Intelligent refactoring of TLA+ specifications (e.g., managing
UNCHANGED
correctly when adding variables)
LLM-enhanced linters, formatters, or other development tools
LLM-driven tools for automated grading in education
Visualizations of specifications or execution traces
Generation of type annotations for tools like Apalache
Synthesis of inductive invariant candidates, validated via
TLC
or
Apalache
Synthesis of
TLAPS
proofs
Synthesis of entire specifications from source code and design documents
Evaluation
Submissions will be judged by the
TLA+ Specification Language Committee (SLC)
The Jury will evaluate submissions based on their functionality, relevance to the TLA+ ecosystem, and the thoughtful use of AI. Submissions must be reproducible by the Jury. Passive formats, such as videos alone, are not sufficient. However, the Jury does not require a fully polished product—a prototype is sufficient. All submissions must be released under the
MIT license
, and any underlying AI models must be publicly available.
The use of GenAI/LLMs is explicitly encouraged, provided that any AI-generated content—such as specs, invariants, visualizations, … —is checked using some form of verification such as the TLA+ tools.
Catch the
live announcement
at the
TLA+ Community Event 2025
!
Participation Criteria
Eligible participants must meet the following:
Prior engagement with the TLA+ community (e.g., contribution to
mailing lists
,
forums
,
open-source repositories
,
conference presentations
, or
academic publications
)
Must not be a member of the TLA+ Foundation Board or Specification Language Committee
Must not be subject to any legal, contractual, export control, or jurisdictional restrictions that would preclude participation
Submission Timeline & Announcement
Submissions will open alongside this announcement. The deadline to submit entries for the challenge is two months from the announcement date on 07/03/2025. Submissions must be sent to
genai@tlapl.us
. The jury will select the winner one month after the submission period closes. We welcome innovative, technically robust, and practically valuable contributions that explore and expand the potential of GenAI within the context of TLA+.
For longer-term or foundational engineering and research efforts related to TLA+, we encourage you to explore the
TLA+ grant program
.

data.title: Show HN: PageQL – Embed SQL directly in HTML
data.author: xiphias2
data.article_summary: PageQL是一个实验性模板语言和微型Python web框架，允许直接在HTML中嵌入SQL。它受ColdFusion和HTMX启发，旨在简化涉及关系数据的网页开发。通过少量核心特性，PageQL支持常见的网站功能，如列表、表单和CRUD操作，同时将高级功能留给扩展。其主要标签包括#from（查询和循环数据库数据）、#insert/#update/#delete（数据操作）和#if/#else（条件渲染）等。PageQL强调声明式编程，利用SQL引擎进行表达式计算，避免复杂脚本。其设计简单、可嵌入且性能良好，未来计划支持反应式模式、客户端离线模式和SQL数据库自动同步等功能。目前，PageQL适用于 hobbyist 项目并欢迎反馈。

43905771.article_content:
What is PageQL? PageQL is an experimental template language and micro Python web framework that allows embedding SQL inside HTML directly. It was inspired by ColdFusion language that allows embedding SQL and Handlebars / Moustache logic-less templates and also HTMX that simplifies web development. Installation pip install pageql pageql data.db templates --create Start Tutorial Core Philosophy PageQL aims to simplify web development involving relational data by allowing direct embedding of SQL-like queries within HTML templates. ✦ Minimal The language fully embraces SQL and HTML and adds as few features as needed to implement the common 80 % of web site features—lists, forms, CRUD—while leaving power-user cases to extensions ✦ Declarative Focus While control structures exist, extensive scripting is discouraged to maintain clarity. ✦ Leverages SQL PageQL relies on the underlying SQL engine for expression evaluation, rather than implementing its own complex expression language. Key Tags #from - Query and loop over database data #insert / #update / #delete - SQL data manipulation commands #set - Set variables #param - Validate and bind request parameters #import - Import modules #partial - Create reusable template blocks #render - Render imported modules or partials with parameters #if / #else / #ifdef / #ifndef - Conditional rendering #redirect - HTTP redirects Example Code PageQL Example {{!-- Ensure the table exists (harmless if already created) --}} {{#create table if not exists todos ( id INTEGER PRIMARY KEY AUTOINCREMENT , text TEXT NOT NULL , completed INTEGER DEFAULT 0 CHECK ( completed IN ( 0 , 1 )) )}} Todos (read‑only)

Todos

    {{!-- 🚀 Query & loop in one tag --}} {{#from todos ORDER BY id }}
  • {{ text }}
    • {{/from}}
Future plans PageQL was built with a simple core language but lots of extensibility in mind ✦ Embeddable, simple, performant While the current implementation is in Python, the language is designed to be simple enough to be reimplemented in any language (C / C++ / Rust / JavaScript...) ✦ Reactivity The language was designed to have a relational reactive mode. As both HTML and SQL are declarative, it's much easier to reason about then if an imperative language is used as a glue . ✦ Client based, offline mode with SQL database automatic syncing. Lots of web frameworks get very complex when client and server code is mixed. PageQL solves it by creating a simple SQL change synchronization protocol as an orthogonal project. As long as reactive SQL updates are used, and SQL database is the main data store, the cognitive overhead remains low with this approach. ✦ Moustache / Handlebars / Jinja like templating API As PageQL combines a micro web framework with a templating engine, templating can be used directly as well from other frameworks, it's just not documented yet. ✦ Advanced routing, importing modules, authentication, authorization, production deployment, optimization As PageQL is a micro framework / experiment, right now it's for hobbyist projects and feedback.
43905771.article_summary: PageQL是一个实验性模板语言和微型Python web框架，允许直接在HTML中嵌入SQL。它受ColdFusion和HTMX启发，旨在简化涉及关系数据的网页开发。通过少量核心特性，PageQL支持常见的网站功能，如列表、表单和CRUD操作，同时将高级功能留给扩展。其主要标签包括#from（查询和循环数据库数据）、#insert/#update/#delete（数据操作）和#if/#else（条件渲染）等。PageQL强调声明式编程，利用SQL引擎进行表达式计算，避免复杂脚本。其设计简单、可嵌入且性能良好，未来计划支持反应式模式、客户端离线模式和SQL数据库自动同步等功能。目前，PageQL适用于 hobbyist 项目并欢迎反馈。

data.title: When Abandoned Mines Collapse
data.author: impish9208
data.article_summary: 2024至2025年间，美国新泽西州Wharton附近的I-80公路多次出现巨大塌陷坑，导致交通延误。调查发现，这些问题源于一个多世纪前该地区的地下铁矿开采活动。由于矿区被遗忘和缺乏记录，许多矿道早已废弃且未被妥善处理，导致地面塌陷。此类地下采矿活动，尤其是煤矿开采，常采用“房柱法”，即在开采后留下柱子支撑顶部。然而，过度采掘导致支撑不足，最终可能引发地面塌陷。此外，地表权和矿权的分离使得问题更加复杂，房主对地下情况缺乏控制。这一问题不仅影响交通，还对居住安全构成威胁。

43908261.article_content:
[Note that this article is a transcript of the video embedded above.]
In December of 2024, a huge sinkhole opened up on I-80 near Wharton, New Jersey, creating massive traffic delays as crews worked to figure out what happened and get it fixed. Since then, it happened again in February 2025 and then again in March. Each time, the highway had to be shut down, creating a nightmare for commuters who had to find alternate routes. And it’s a nightmare for the DOT, too, trying to make sure this highway is safe to drive on despite it literally collapsing into the earth. From what we know so far, this is not a natural phenomenon, but one that’s human-made. It looks like all these issues were set in motion more than a century ago when the area had numerous underground iron mines. This is a really complex issue that causes problems around the world, and I built a little model mine in my garage to show you why it’s such a big deal. I’m Grady and this is Practical Engineering.
We’ve been extracting material and minerals from the earth since way before anyone was writing things down. It’s probably safe to say that things started at the surface. You notice something shiny or differently colored on the side of a hill or cliff and you take it out. Over time, we built up knowledge about what materials were valuable, where they existed, and how to efficiently extract them from the earth. But, of course, there’s only so much earth at the surface. Eventually, you have to start digging. Maybe you follow a vein of gold, silver, copper, coal or sulfur down below the surface. And things start to get more complicated because now you’re in a hole. And holes are kind of dangerous. They’re dark, they fill with water, they can collapse, and they collect dangerous gases. So, in many cases, even today, it makes sense to remove the overburden - the soil and rock above the mineral or material you’re after. Mining on the surface has a lot of advantages when it comes to cost and safety.
But there are situations where surface mining isn’t practical. Removing overburden is expensive, and it gets more expensive the deeper you go. It also has environmental impacts like habitat destruction and pollution of air and water. So, as technology, safety, and our understanding of soil and rock mechanics grew, so did our ability to go straight to the source and extract minerals underground.
One of the major materials that drove the move to underground mining was coal. It’s usually found in horizontal formations called seams, that formed when vast volumes of paleozoic plants were buried and then crushed and heated over geologic time. At the start of the Industrial Revolution, coal quickly became a primary source of energy for steam engines, steel refining, and electricity generation. Those coal seams vary in thickness, and they vary in depth below the surface too, so many early coal mines were underground.
In the early days of underground mining, there was not a lot of foresight. Some might argue that’s still true, but it was a lot more so a couple hundred years ago. Coal mining companies weren’t creating detailed maps of their mines, and even if they did, there was no central archive to send them to. And they just weren’t that concerned about the long-term stability of the mines once the resources had been extracted. All that mattered was getting coal out of the ground. Mining companies came and went, dissolved or were acquired, and over time, a lot of information about where mines existed and their condition was just lost. And even though many mines were in rural areas, far away from major population centers, some weren’t, and some of those rural areas became major population centers without any knowledge about what had happened underneath them decades ago.
An issue that confounds the problem of mine subsidence is that in a lot of places, property ownership is split into two pieces: surface rights and mineral rights. And those rights can be owned by different people. So if you’re a homeowner, you may own the surface rights to your land, while a company owns the right to drill or mine under your property. That doesn’t give them the right to damage your property, but it does make things more complicated since you don’t always have a say in what’s happening beneath the surface.
There are myriad ways to build and operate underground mines, but especially for soft rock mining, like coal, the predominant method for decades was called “room and pillar”. This is exactly what it sounds like. You excavate the ore, bringing material to the surface. But you leave columns to support the roof. The size, shape, and spacing of columns are dictated by the strength of the material. This is really important because a mine like this has major fixed costs: exploration, planning, access, ventilation, and haulage. 主要讨论点：印巴冲突的现状、潜在升级风险及各方反应

不同观点：
• nblgbg认为冲突被夸大，印度和巴基斯坦都没有真正的战争意愿。印度政府为了展示力量，选择在巴控克什米尔进行行动，而巴基斯坦的反击声明缺乏证据支持。最终双方可能只是边境交火，各自宣称胜利。
• dd_xplore支持印度的行动，认为是对庇护恐怖分子的国家的正当回应，并批评巴基斯坦的民族主义情绪和可能的选举策略。
• dd_xplore进一步指出，民族主义对经济不利，巴基斯坦不应自我破坏。
• MichaelMoser123指出印度暂停《印度河水条约》可能导致冲突升级，并引用相关新闻支持其观点。
• digitalPhonix对巴基斯坦声称击落印度五架飞机的说法表示怀疑，要求更多细节和证实。
• Animats警告如果军事行动超出克什米尔地区，可能会演变为重大战争。
• ferguess_k希望冲突在初始轰炸和射击后冷却，认为民族主义情绪得到满足后，双方可能会回到对峙状态。
• neom从资本主义后期理论角度分析，认为商业竞争和战争有相似之处，且在当前经济环境下，真正的创业机会减少可能导致更多冲突。

补充讨论：
• 多个用户（如suraci和aaron695）提到印巴历史冲突和当前国际立场，例如印度支持以色列和1999年的卡吉尔战争。
• 2Gkashmiri尝试提供实时报道，增加讨论的真实性。
• 部分用户（如asdf6969和faizan-ali）表达了对冲突的个人情感和担忧。

争议的焦点：
• 巴基斯坦是否真的击落了印度的飞机，以及双方声明的可信度。
• 印巴冲突是否会进一步升级为更大规模的战争，特别是考虑到核武器的因素。
• 民族主义情绪和经济之间的矛盾，特别是在巴基斯坦可能的选举策略中。

总体来看，讨论围绕印巴冲突的现状、潜在风险、各方反应以及冲突对经济和社会的可能影响展开。

data.author: rohitpaulk
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：OpenAI的结构转变及其影响

不同观点：
• **对AGI市场非赢家通吃模式的认可**：atlasunshrugged认为，OpenAI的领导层似乎认为AGI市场不会是一个赢家通吃的市场，并指出其从复杂的利润上限结构转向更简单的资本结构是合理的。
• **对AGI发展及其潜在影响的担忧**：pants2对许多公司在公众面前公然宣称正在创造一个比核武器更强大的数字神明表示担忧，认为这并没有引起足够的重视。
• **避免重蹈Web 1.0覆辙的呼声**：A_Duck担心当前的转变可能会重演Web 1.0从社区资源向广告驱动、用户敌对模式的转变。
• **对AGI发展现状的质疑**：amelius质疑Altman对AGI的讨论，认为我们还不清楚AGI将如何构建或使用。
• **对OpenAI结构转变背后的动机的批评**：drewbeck认为OpenAI的转变反映了其领导层从“做好事”到更为专制、自我中心的转变，不再掩饰其追求权力的本质。

补充讨论：
• **对非盈利控制权的质疑**：Tenoke认为OpenAI去除利润上限并转向公共利益公司（PBC）像是舍弃了最后的圣洁，而modeless则质疑非盈利是否真的会保持控制权，或者这只是暂时的策略。
• **对PBC结构的法律疑问**：everybodyknows请求商业人士解释公共利益公司（PBC）与其他注册形式的区别。
• **对AI发展的整体怀疑**：GPerson认为AI的一切都是 fraudulent（欺诈的），而jjani则具体分析了OpenAI在与科技巨头竞争中的劣势，认为其正在失去竞争优势。
• **对Altman个人利益的关注**：lolinder指出Altman通过结构转变获得了个人财富增长的机会，质疑其对非盈利和新的营利结构的控制。
• **对公司信件的讽刺**：etruong42认为OpenAI的信件与Google创始人的IPO信件有相似之处，可能是有意模仿或由AI生成。

争议焦点：
• OpenAI的结构转变是否真正为了公共利益，还是为了个人和公司财富的最大化。
• AGI发展的现状及其潜在影响是否被过度炒作，或者是否应该更加关注其当前的影响。

其他值得注意的讨论点：
• 对OpenAI在与大型科技公司竞争中的未来表示担忧。
• 呼吁关注AI技术已经带来的影响，而不仅仅是未来可能的伦理问题。

data.title: Performance Improvements in JDK 24
data.author: todsacerdoti
data.article_summary: 文章总结了JDK 24相对于JDK 23的性能改进，主要集中在对外部函数与内存API（FFM API）的优化。通过避免对较小内存段进行Java到原生代码的转换，提升了`MemorySegment`的`fill`、`copy`和`mismatch`等批量操作的性能。具体改进包括：对小内存段（默认小于64字节）直接使用纯Java代码执行操作，而非调用原生代码。用户可通过系统属性自定义阈值大小。在Linux X64平台上，改进后的`MemorySegment::fill`速度显著提升，其他平台和操作也有类似效果。新操作被封装在`jdk.internal.foreign.SegmentBulkOperation`类中，按数据类型逐步处理。AArch64平台因缺乏内在实现，默认阈值较高（1024字节）。

Performance Improvements in JDK 24
Claes Redestad
,

on
March 19, 2025
This article summarizes the performance improvements made in JDK 24 compared to JDK 23 by highlighting some of the most noteworthy progressions. In order to facilitate traceability, the improvements are listed per issue (or per umbrella issue explained in the note below) as entered into the official JDK Bug System. Let’s check them all out!
“Umbrella issues” are parent issues that consist of a number of sub-issues which are related to each other.  Keeping related issues together is great when working with larger tasks that could affect many distinct parts of the JDK.
Core Libraries
JDK-8340821
Umbrella: Improve FFM Bulk Operations
This enhancement is a part of a series aimed at improving the performance of the Foreign Function & Memory API (FFM API) that was finalized back in Java 22. Here are all the issues under this umbrella:
JDK-8338967
Improve Performance for MemorySegment::fill
JDK-8338591
Improve performance of MemorySegment::copy
JDK-8339531
Improve performance of MemorySegment::mismatch
JDK-8339527
Adjust threshold for MemorySegment::fill native invocation
In short, these bulk operations on segments were previously made via
Unsafe
methods which require a transition from Java to native code. Many times, native code is faster than Java code once the price of transition is paid. However, for a smaller segment, it has become evident that transitioning to native code is not worth the price.
Here is an example on how to create a small segment filled with
0xFF
(using
fill

segment
=

allocate
(

fill
((
byte
)
0xFF
);
The idea behind all the improvements in this series is to check if the participating segment(s) are “small” and if so, perform the bulk operation using pure Java code rather than transitioning to native code. The “small” size partition threshold (which is always a power of two) is set to a reasonable default value (usually 2^6 = 64 bytes).
Via three new system properties, the partition thresholds can be set to bespoke values. In the example below, we have increased all the thresholds levels to 2
12
= 4,096 bytes via command line parameters:
-Djava.lang.foreign.native.threshold.power.fill=12
-Djava.lang.foreign.native.threshold.power.copy=12
-Djava.lang.foreign.native.threshold.power.mismatch=12
By setting the threshold power values to zero, the old Unsafe-only path will be taken and consequently, these enhancements will be disabled.
Currently, there is no intrinsic implementation for
MemorySegment::fill

10

43909155.article_summary: 文章总结了JDK 24相对于JDK 23的性能改进，主要集中在对外部函数与内存API（FFM API）的优化。通过避免对较小内存段进行Java到原生代码的转换，提升了`MemorySegment`的`fill`、`copy`和`mismatch`等批量操作的性能。具体改进包括：对小内存段（默认小于64字节）直接使用纯Java代码执行操作，而非调用原生代码。用户可通过系统属性自定义阈值大小。在Linux X64平台上，改进后的`MemorySegment::fill`速度显著提升，其他平台和操作也有类似效果。新操作被封装在`jdk.internal.foreign.SegmentBulkOperation`类中，按数据类型逐步处理。AArch64平台因缺乏内在实现，默认阈值较高（1024字节）。

data.title: Bloat is still software's biggest vulnerability (2024)
data.author: kristianp
data.article_summary:
本文讨论了软件膨胀（bloat）仍然是软件最大的漏洞问题。作者Daniel Zender回顾了1995年Niklaus Wirth提出的“精简软件”的呼吁，并指出近30年后情况仍未改善。现代软件往往包含数百万行代码和大量未知来源的外部库，导致安全问题频发，甚至大型科技公司也犯下基本的安全错误。

文章强调软件安全形势严峻，建议通过立法（如欧盟的NIS2、网络弹性法案和产品责任指令）来提升软件质量。作者分析了当前问题 partly 源于经济激励，因为快速推出不安全软件能节省时间和成本。最后，作者分享了自己编写简约但现代软件的实践，呼吁业内人士共同改善现状。

总之，软件确实变得异常复杂和危险，需要更多关注和改进。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：软件依赖管理、代码臃肿（bloat）及其对开发和安全的影响

不同观点：
• GuB-42认为，C/C++中传统的依赖管理不便反而可能是件好事。虽然现代包管理工具如npm、Maven、Cargo非常方便，但容易导致引入大量未知来源的包和代码，最终代码库变得难以管理。而C的传统方式迫使开发者慎重考虑每个库，甚至自己实现功能，从而保持代码的简洁。
  
• dvh指出，代码臃肿往往体现在过度的间接层次上。简单的修改（如按钮颜色）可能需要修改多个文件和模块，导致开发效率低下，项目维护成本增加。

• BobbyTables2批评了现代库的粗粒度和不必要的功能集成。例如，一个简单的Web服务器可能附带了大量不相关的功能和协议支持，导致开发者为了避免复杂的依赖链而重新实现某些功能。

• bob1029强调了减少第三方依赖的重要性，以确保漏洞出现时能够快速响应。过多的依赖会增加系统脆弱性，任何一环的故障都会导致整个系统失效。

• ronbenton指出，即使是拥有大量资源的大型科技公司也会犯安全错误，因此在招聘时应更关注候选人对软件工程的理解，而不是解谜能力。

• dmos62以讽刺的方式表达了对软件行业混乱文化的无奈，认为诸如臃肿、封闭源代码和缺乏互操作性等问题是文化自我矛盾的体现。

• boznz提到，如果不使用现代框架或大规模云堆栈，可能会被认为是过时和脱节的，尽管这些技术可能带来不必要的复杂性。

• dang引用了2024年一篇关于精简软件的讨论文章，指出这个问题在行业内已经存在很长时间。

• gitroom认为，额外的代码堆积往往是因为开发者追求简单的安装或显得忙碌，而不是保持事情的简单性。

• al_borland指出，团队被期望快速交付，导致没有时间回溯和优化代码，从而产生技术债务。

• kristianp认为，软件臃肿的问题不在于依赖本身，而在于对依赖代码的质量控制。通过死代码消除等技术可以减少最终产品的臃肿。

• antfarm分享了自己学习Elixir和OTP以克服架构臃肿的经历，认为构建自定义解决方案可以避免引入过多的第三方组件。

• hilbert42总结了软件臃肿和安全问题的广泛影响，认为由于商业利益和技术生态的复杂性，这些问题在短期内难以解决。

补充讨论：
• jongjong描述了在工作中为了运行软件需要启动多个微服务，导致开发环境配置复杂且耗时，反映了现代开发环境中的操作复杂性。

争议焦点：
• 软件臃肿的定义和其对开发效率及安全的影响是讨论的核心。一部分人认为现代工具和框架带来的便利超过了其复杂性，而另一部分人则认为不必要的功能和依赖导致了维护困难和安全隐患。

Computing
Magazine
Feature
April 2024
Why Bloat Is Still Software’s Biggest Vulnerability
A 2024 plea for lean software
Bert Hubert
08 Feb 2024
10 min read
Daniel Zender
This post is dedicated to the memory of
Niklaus Wirth
, a computing pioneer who passed away 1 January 2024. In 1995 he wrote an influential article called “
A Plea for Lean Software
,”
published in
Computer
, the magazine for members of the
IEEE Computer Society
, which I read early in my career as an entrepreneur and software developer. In what follows, I try to make the same case nearly 30 years later, updated for today’s computing horrors. A version of this post was
originally published
on my personal blog,
Berthub.eu
.
Some years ago I did a talk at a local university on
cybersecurity
, titled “
Cyber and Information Security: Have We All Gone Mad?
” It is still worth reading today since we
have
gone quite mad collectively.
The way we build and ship software these days is mostly ridiculous, leading to apps using millions of lines of code to open a garage door, and other simple programs importing
1,600 external code libraries
—dependencies—of unknown provenance.
Software security
is dire, which is a function both of the quality of the code and the sheer amount of it. Many of us
programmers
know the current situation is untenable. Many programmers (and their management) sadly haven’t ever experienced anything else. And for the rest of us, we rarely get the time to do a better job.
It is not just you; we are not merely suffering from nostalgia: Software really is very weird today.
Let me briefly go over the terrible state of software security, and then spend some time on why it is so bad. I also mention some regulatory and legislative things going on that we might use to make software quality a priority again. Finally, I talk about
an actual useful piece of software I wrote
as a proof of concept that one can still make
minimal and simple yet modern software
.
I hope that this post provides some mental and moral support for suffering programmers and technologists who want to improve things. It is not just you; We are not merely suffering from nostalgia: Software really is very weird today.
The terrible state of software security
Without going all
“Old man (48) yells at cloud
,” let me restate some obvious things. The state of software security is
dire
. If we only look at the past year, if you ran industry-standard software like
Ivanti
,
MOVEit
,
Outlook
,
Confluence
,
Barracuda Email Security Gateway
,
Citrix NetScaler ADC, and NetScaler Gateway
, chances are you got hacked. Even companies with near-infinite resources (like Apple and
Google
) made
trivial “worst practice” security mistakes
that put
their customers in danger
. Yet we continue to rely on all these products.
Software is now (rightfully) considered so dangerous that we tell everyone not to run it themselves.
Software is now (rightfully) considered so dangerous that we tell everyone not to run it themselves. Instead, you are supposed to leave that to an “
X
as a service” provider, or perhaps just to “the cloud.” Compare this to a hypothetical situation where cars are so likely to catch fire that the advice is not to drive a car yourself, but to leave that to professionals who are always accompanied by professional firefighters.
The assumption is then that the cloud is somehow able to make insecure software trustworthy. Yet in the past year, we’ve learned that Microsoft’s
email platform was thoroughly hacked
, including classified government email. (
Twice!
) There are also
well-founded worries about the security of the Azure cloud
. Meanwhile, industry darling Okta, which provides cloud-based software that enables user log-in to various applications,
got comprehensively owned
. This was their second breach within two years. Also, there was a suspicious spate of Okta users subsequently getting hacked.
Clearly, we need better software.
The
European Union
has launched three pieces of
legislation
to this effect:
NIS2 for important services
; the
Cyber Resilience Act
for almost all commercial software and electronic devices; and a revamped
Product Liability Directive
that also extends to software. Legislation is always hard, and it remains to be seen
if they got it right
. But that software security is terrible enough these days to warrant legislation seems obvious.
Why software security is so bad
I want to touch on incentives. The situation today is clearly working well for commercial operators. Making more secure software takes time and is a lot of work, and the current security incidents don’t appear to be impacting the bottom line or stock prices. You can
speed up time to market by cutting corners
. So from an economic standpoint, what we see is entirely predictable. Legislation could be very important in changing this equation.
The security of software depends on two factors—the
density
of security issues in the
source code
and the sheer
amount of code
accessible by
hackers
. A

data.title: FTC bans hidden fees for live events and short-term rentals, effective May 12
data.author: toomuchtodo
data.article_summary: 美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）发布了新的《不公平或欺骗性费用规则》，将于5月12日生效。该规则禁止在现场活动、酒店和短期租赁中隐藏费用，并禁止“诱购定价”等误导性行为，要求所有已知费用必须包含在总价中。企业必须在广告和报价中提前披露总价，且总价需比其他价格信息更显著展示。规则还禁止使用模糊术语如“便利费”或“处理费”，并要求明确说明 excluded 费用。动态定价仍允许，但不得误导。Airbnb等平台已提前调整以符合新规。该规则旨在提高价格透明度，保护消费者权益。
data.comments_summary:

• **[yieldcrv]** 支持票务网站已实施的变革，认为这有助于消费者判断某项活动是否在预算范围内。不过，仍然认为费用本身过高，不合理。

• **[ChrisMarshallNY]** 提到日本酒店按实际住宿晚数收费，无额外费用，对比美国酒店可能有额外收费，暗示了对美国酒店收费透明度的关注。

• **[idontwantthis]** 希望规定能包括拉斯维加斯酒店的“度假费用”，表明对特定类型住宿额外收费的关注。

The U.S. Federal Trade Commission (FTC) on Monday
released
new documentation detailing its new “
Rule on Unfair or Deceptive Fees
.” The rule, set to take effect on May 12, prohibits hidden fees for live events, hotels, and short-term rentals. It also bans practices such as “bait-and-switch pricing” and any actions that conceal or misrepresent total prices and fees.
In a newly published FAQ, the FTC offers a guide for these types of businesses, providing detailed information about pricing transparency.
The rule will
impact businesses
, including live-event ticket sellers and short-term lodging providers, like hotels, motels, Airbnb, or VRBO. Third-party platforms, resellers, and travel agents are also covered by the new regulation. (Airbnb already
updated its service in advance of this new regulation
to show users the total cost of their stay upfront.)
According to the FTC:
Live-event tickets include those for concerts, sporting events, music, theater, and other live performances that audiences watch as they occur, but not pre-recorded audio or visual performances.
The total price must include all known charges and fees.
Sites must disclose the total price upfront in ads and other offers for live-event tickets or short-term lodging.
The total price must also be more prominently displayed than any other pricing information.
There should be no misrepresentation about fees and charges.
Sites should provide truthful information about fees, including refund policies.
Sites should avoid vague terms like “convenience fees,” “service fees,” or “processing fees.”
Dynamic pricing strategies are still allowed as long as the pricing information isn’t misleading.
Also included in the FTC’s new FAQ are the types of fees that can be excluded, such as taxes or government fees, shipping charges, and charges for optional goods or services people may select to buy as part of the same transaction. (Note that handling charges aren’t on this list.)
However, the FTC notes that businesses must disclose that it has excluded charges from the total price before asking for payment. For example, if a business excludes shipping charges from the advertised price, it’s required to clearly state the amount and purpose of those charges.
The FTC first passed the rule in December 2024, a landmark regulation that marked a significant win for consumers who have been frustrated for years about hidden fees.

43910794.article_summary: 美国联邦贸易委员会（FTC）发布了新的《不公平或欺骗性费用规则》，将于5月12日生效。该规则禁止在现场活动、酒店和短期租赁中隐藏费用，并禁止“诱购定价”等误导性行为，要求所有已知费用必须包含在总价中。企业必须在广告和报价中提前披露总价，且总价需比其他价格信息更显著展示。规则还禁止使用模糊术语如“便利费”或“处理费”，并要求明确说明 excluded 费用。动态定价仍允许，但不得误导。Airbnb等平台已提前调整以符合新规。该规则旨在提高价格透明度，保护消费者权益。

data.title: Show HN: Whippy Term - GUI terminal for embedded development (Linux and Windows)
data.author: SurvivorTed
data.article_summary: WhippyTerm是一款现代终端程序，支持Windows和Linux系统，拥有现代用户界面和多种独特功能。它主要面向嵌入式开发者，支持串行通信（如RS232、RS485、RS422、TTL UART）和网络协议（TCP/IP、UDP），并通过插件支持I2C和SPI协议。该程序内置书签、十六进制 dumps功能，并可通过插件扩展。它还支持二进制和ASCII数据块的发送，适用于处理串行流和消息块协议如UDP，内置ANSI终端仿真，并可通过插件添加其他仿真如VT100。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：新发布的跨平台串行终端工具及其功能和局限

不同观点：
• alias_neo: 认为该工具看起来很不错，尤其是对于较少进行嵌入式开发的人来说，像ESPHome这样的工具已经减少了手动构建的需求。不过，作为Linux用户，连接minicom或screen时的语法记忆让他感到有些烦恼。尽管目前无法提供更多反馈，但这个工具激励他考虑新的嵌入式项目来尝试。

• AriedK: 对工具的send buffers和实时显示功能表示赞赏，但指出缺少像Tera Term中的“禁用 incoming 串流自动滚动”的选项，特别是类似于Tera Term的“仅在最底行自动滚动”功能。

• SurvivorTed: 作为该工具的开发者，SurvivorTed介绍了该工具的设计目标和功能，包括支持Linux和Windows系统，现代GUI界面（如标签页、可拉出面板等），以及支持二进制协议、ANSI转义序列、XModem协议、二进制块、十六进制转储、桥接两个连接等功能。他发布了工具的源链接并希望大家试用。

• 该工具的功能和设计目标主要集中在满足嵌入式开发者的需求，特别是在Linux和Windows平台上的使用。

• macOS用户的兼容性问题被提出，显示出该工具在跨平台支持上的局限性。

Home
Whippy Term
Whippy Term is a modern terminal program.  It has been designed to have
a modern UI and to run on modern OS's like Windows and Linux.  It also
has a number of unique features such as bookmarks, built in hex dumps,
extending through plugins, and native support for binary protocols.
Embedded Developers
It is primarily aimed at embedded developers that need to talk to their
devices. It supports serial communication such as serial ports
(RS232, RS485, RS422, TTL UART), TCP/IP, UDP. It also supports
protocols such as I2C and SPI though plugins.
Terminal emulations
Terminal emulations such as ANSI and VT100 can be added (ANSI is builtin
and always available) through plugins.
Binary protocols
WhippyTerm also support working with binary protocols, in both
serial streams like RS232, and message block protocols like UDP.
Support for sending blocks of binary or AscII data is included to
better work with embedded devices and binary protocols.

data.title: Sutton and Barto book implementation
data.author: ivanbelenky
data.article_summary: 该文章介绍了一个GitHub仓库，其中包含实现Sutton的《Reinforcement Learning: An Introduction》一书中算法和模型的代码。仓库代码涵盖多种强化学习方法，包括多臂老虎机、蒙特卡罗方法、时序差分学习、Dyna-Q规划、演员-评论家算法等。代码按不同主题模块化，用户可以通过定义状态、动作和转移函数来使用无模型求解器。文章还提供了单状态无限方差示例和蒙特卡罗树搜索迷宫求解的代码示例。尽管该仓库为基础实现，非生产就绪，但为学习强化学习算法提供了宝贵资源。仓库使用MIT许可证，已有45个星标和5个分支。

data.article_summary: "Old Timey Mono" 是一种基于1906年 Reproducing Typewriter 字体设计的等宽字体，专为提升可读性和避免复制失真设计，适合编码和剧本写作。它包括常规版和代码专用版，后者具有更易辨识的字符设计。该字体支持广泛的语言和字符集，包括拉丁字母、西里尔字母和希腊字母，并涵盖多种 Unicode 区块。字体适用于多种操作系统，并为不同环境提供了字体平滑建议。该项目文件包含源代码、二进制文件和相关资源，用户可以从发布页面下载。

SPECIMEN
https://webonastick.com/fonts/old-timey-mono/
About
A clean monospace typeface based on Reproducing Typewriter which was
available as early as 1906.  Reproducing Typewriter was designed for
simulating typewritten letters in smaller point sizes for
advertisements, catalogs, etc., where readability and/or distortion
resulting from duplication were issues with faces based on actual
typewriters at the time.
"Sight Saver" typewriter faces designed for readability were also
available, though they were at larger sizes than ordinary pica or
elite typefaces.
I developed Old Timey Mono because I thought those characteristics
would make it a good basis for a coding font with an antique
aesthetic.  You may have seen Reproducing Typewriter used in the
Turbo Pascal 3.0
product manual.
At a size of 12pt (6 lines per inch), Old Timey Mono is a pica font,
or 10 characters per inch, like Courier.  It
should
be suitable
for screenplay writing.
Code Variant
Along with Old Timey Mono, there is Old Timey Code.  It has a slashed
zero, disambiguated digit one, selected punctuation marks made larger,
and a few certain small letters modified.
Mintty Users
Text -> Font Smoothing -> Partial.  I wish I didn't have to tell you
to do this.
Character Set Coverage
Extensive coverage of Latin, Cyrillic, and Greek scripts.  Language
support is detailed below.
Includes the following sets of characters in their entirety (excepting
controls):
ASCII
ISO-8859-1
Code Page 437
Code Page 850
Windows Glyph List 4 (WGL4)
Adobe Glyph List for New Fonts (AGLFN)
Windows 1252's additional characters
Mac OS Roman, except for the ff and fi ligatures (which don't belong in monospace fonts)
The following Unicode blocks in their entirety:
U+2500–U+257F Box Drawing
U+2580–U+259F Block Elements
U+2800–U+28FF Braille Patterns
U+0100–U+017F Latin Extended-A
And then some.
And a few extras!

At least according to

.  As

data.title: Understanding effective type Aliasing in C [pdf]
data.author: quelsolaar
data.article_summary: 无法获取文章内容
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：C语言中使用union进行类型转换的合法性及有效类型（effective type）的概念

不同观点：
• **[pansa2的观点]**：pansa2认为，当union包含内存的有效类型时，通过union访问内存是合法的。他提供了一个例子，其中`union`包含`int`和`float`类型，并指出即便从未使用`union`中的`f`成员，只要`union`包含`int`类型，通过`i`成员访问是合法的。他还提到有人建议避免使用union进行类型转换，而应使用`memcpy`，并询问union方法在C中是否有问题，或者是否在C++中被认为是未定义行为。

• **[cancerhacker的观点]**：cancerhacker从更底层的角度看待问题，认为C语言编写代码时应考虑到其如何编译为汇编语言。他强调了理解代码如何在底层执行的重要性，并建议开发者使用工具（如godbolt.org或编译器的`-save-temps`标志）来观察生成的汇编代码。他批评了现代开发者缺乏对底层机制的理解，甚至开玩笑地表示对新一代开发者不熟悉命令行编译感到不满。

• **[jklowden的观点]**：jklowden对有效类型的概念表示强烈不满，特别是当涉及到静态分配、堆栈分配和堆分配的变量时。他认为，无论数据是在堆上通过`malloc`分配的还是在其他地方分配的，都应该有明确的类型定义。他批评了标准委员会在类型系统上的决策，认为这些决策没有为开发者提供实际的帮助。

补充讨论：
• 争议的焦点在于C语言中使用union进行类型转换的合法性及有效类型的定义。pansa2关注union的实际使用效果及与C++的不同，而jklowden则对有效类型的概念本身提出质疑，认为其不利于实际开发。

• 另一个值得注意的讨论点是cancerhacker对底层汇编语言的理解及其对现代开发者技能的看法，这虽然不是直接的技术争议，但体现了对C语言底层执行机制的重视。

• 最后，pansa2提到的`memcpy`方法与union方法的对比，以及在C和C++中的不同行为，也是讨论的一个重要方面。

data.title: The DEA is now abandoning body cameras
data.author: bookofjoe
data.article_summary: 美国缉毒局（DEA）在开始实施执法记录仪计划不到四年后，悄然终止了该项目。根据ProPublica获得的内部邮件，DEA称此举是为了与特朗普总统撤销2022年联邦执法人员使用执法记录仪要求的行政命令保持一致。然而，美国法警局和烟酒枪炮及爆炸物管理局等其他至少两个联邦执法机构仍继续要求使用执法记录仪。DEA未公开宣布这一政策变化，其网站上相关页面链接也已失效。前联邦检察官担忧此举会给DEA特工带来困难，因为记录仪有助于澄清指控。司法部曾强调记录仪能增强警察问责制和公众信任。尽管合同仍有效，但仅使用了约六分之一的资金。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：执法记录仪（Body Cam）与执法部门的问责问题，以及其潜在的正面和负面影响

不同观点：
• **JohnMakin的观点**：认为执法记录仪在帮助警察洗清不当行为方面有积极作用，但当不当行为变得普遍时，记录仪可能会成为警方的负担。他引用了一种常见的警察说法，即“如果你没做错事，那你有什么好隐藏的”，以此质疑执法记录仪在未来可能成为警方的 liability（负担或责任）。

• **sjsdiuasgdia的观点**：认为现政府普遍缺乏问责，因此对JohnMakin的观点表示认同。这一评论更倾向于批评政府在整体上对问责的抵触态度，暗示执法记录仪的推行与实际问责效果可能有限。

• **ty6853的观点**：提出执法记录仪可以快速移除，但像大麻合法化进程等更重要的问题却进展缓慢。他的观点质疑了执法部门在某些事务上的优先级，认为像大麻政策改革等应得到更多关注。

• **mountainriver的观点**：提到DEA（美国缉毒局）过去有不当行为的历史，认为许多药物应该被合法化或至少非罪化。他支持拜登发布的一项关于执法记录仪的行政命令，认为这正是当前需要的改革措施，但也暗示执法部门因此获得了更多不必要的权力。

补充讨论：

The DEA Once Touted Body Cameras for Their “Enhanced Transparency.” Now the Agency Is Abandoning Them.
An internal email obtained by ProPublica said the agency made the change to be “consistent” with a Trump executive order. But at least two other federal law enforcement agencies are still requiring body cameras.

Mario Ariza

The Drug Enforcement Administration has quietly ended its body camera program barely four years after it began, according to an internal email obtained by ProPublica.
On April 2, DEA headquarters emailed employees announcing that the program had been terminated effective the day before. The DEA has not publicly announced the policy change, but by early April,
links to pages about body camera policies
on the DEA’s website were broken.
The email said the agency made the change to be “consistent” with a Trump executive order rescinding the 2022 requirement that all federal law enforcement agents use body cameras.
But at least two other federal law enforcement agencies within the Justice Department — the U.S. Marshals Service and the Bureau of Alcohol, Tobacco, Firearms and Explosives — are still requiring body cameras, according to their spokespeople. The FBI referred questions about its body camera policy to the Justice Department, which declined to comment.
The DEA did not respond to questions about its decision to stop using the cameras, saying that the agency “does not comment on tools and techniques.” Reuters reported on the change as part of a story about
budget cuts for law enforcement offices
.
One former federal prosecutor expressed concern that the change would make life more difficult for DEA agents.
“The vast majority of times I viewed body camera footage is based on allegations from a defense attorney about what a cop did,” said David DeVillers, former U.S. attorney for the Southern District of Ohio. “And I would say 95% of the time it absolves the cop of wrongdoing.”
The Justice Department started requiring that its federal agents wear the devices in 2021 in the wake of the protests over George Floyd’s death the previous summer.
“We welcome the addition of body worn cameras and appreciate the enhanced transparency and assurance they provide to the public and to law enforcement officers working hard to keep our communities safe and healthy,” then-DEA Administrator Anne Milgram said in a
Sept. 1, 2021, press release
announcing the use of the cameras.
In May 2022, then-President Joe Biden issued an executive order expanding the use of body cameras to all federal law enforcement officers.
In January, the incoming Trump administration rescinded that order, along with almost 100 others it considered “harmful.”
In early February, U.S. Immigration and Customs Enforcement, which is part of the Department of Homeland Security, was
one of the first agencies to get rid of its body cameras
. Subsequent videos show plainclothes immigration agents making arrests with no visible body cameras.
The DOJ wrote in a 2022 Office of Inspector General management report that the cameras were a “means of enhancing police accountability and the public’s trust in law enforcement.” Studies have consistently shown that departments that use body cameras experience a drop in complaints against officers, according to the
nonprofit Police Executive Research Forum
, though it’s not clear if the drop is due to improvements in officer behavior or to a decrease in frivolous complaints.
“Eliminating these videos is really taking away a tool that we’ve seen be of benefit to law enforcement practices,” said Cameron McEllhiney, executive director of the National Association for Civilian Oversight of Law Enforcement. “It’s also a great teaching tool, besides keeping community members safe from the potential misconduct that could occur.”
The DOJ put a lot of money into the body camera initiative. In August of 2021, it awarded Axon, the company that dominates the body camera market, a $30.4 million contract for cameras and the software to handle the evidence they created. The contract, according to Axon, remains active. But only about one-sixth of it has been paid out, according to
federal contracting data
.
The most recent publicly available version of the DEA’s body camera policy dates to December 2022. It only required agents to wear the devices when they were conducting preplanned arrests or searches and seizures that required a warrant. It also only required DEA officers to wear their body cameras when they were working within the United States.

data.title: Claude's system prompt is over 24k tokens with tools
data.author: mike210
data.article_summary: 这篇文章提到一个名为"system_prompts_leaks"的公共代码库，包含与系统提示相关的泄露信息。用户必须登录才能更改通知设置。该库已有53次被 fork 和265次被标星，显示出一定的关注度。文章内容简短，主要提醒用户注意该库的存在及其潜在影响。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：系统提示词的长度、工具的使用、模型性能与限制、提示词的逻辑结构及作用

不同观点：
• SafeDusk认为，除了使用长系统提示词，还需要为代理提供合适的工具集（如read、write、diff等），以确保其有效运行，并分享了一个工具模板。
• LeoPanthera质疑每次请求消耗大量token的效率问题，建议能否缓存或将状态直接嵌入模型中，以减少提示词长度。
• jdnier提出疑问，Claude的“个性”究竟是来自系统提示词还是底层LLM训练所致，并猜测是否可以通过类似的提示在其他LLM（如ChatGPT）上模拟出Claude的模式。
• eigenblake担心系统提示词的真实性，提出语言模型可能“幻觉”出不存在的系统提示，导致当前流传的提示词未必是真实的。
• mike210引用了Reddit上的讨论，指出该系统提示词长度超过24k token，包含大量具体指令。

补充讨论：
• paradite从RLHF（人类反馈强化学习）的角度分析，认为通过处理系统提示词并收集用户反馈，模型可以逐渐“内化”提示词内容，从而减少对显式提示的依赖。
• 4b11b4对提示词中的逻辑结构（如IF和ELSE IF）表示困惑，认为这些逻辑并未被严格遵循，且对使用的语法格式提出质疑。
• dr_kretyn认为，依赖详细的每步指令降低了模型的“智能性”，期望模型能通过训练自动处理这些任务，而不是每次都需要明确指示。
• photonthug对工具的使用示例表示质疑，特别是一些涉及隐私的操作（如读取Gmail），质疑这些工具是否适合企业客户使用。
• jongjong指出，过长的提示词会降低模型性能，并回忆早期OpenAI的文本生成模型表现更佳，认为当前模型因法律限制而表现下降。
• crawsome抱怨模型在处理项目任务时，经常不遵循用户的明确指示，生成不必要的代码和优化，导致工作效率低下。
• sramam好奇某些工具（如Cursor）是否获得了特殊权限，能够更好地处理diff等任务。
• behnamoh表示，自己禁用了Claude的所有扩展和工具，因为经验表明，函数调用在非函数任务（如编码）中会降低模型性能。
• bjornsing分享了与Claude互动的经历，Claude在使用搜索工具后输出了一大段系统提示，显示出其背后可能有更长的系统提示词在控制其行为。

争议焦点：
• 系统提示词的真实性及其对模型行为的影响（eigenblake vs. 其他评论者）
• 长提示词对模型性能的影响及效率问题（LeoPanthera, jongjong vs. SafeDusk, paradite）
• 工具使用和隐私问题的平衡（photonthug vs. 工具支持者）

总结：讨论围绕系统提示词的长度、工具使用、模型性能及其逻辑结构展开，各方对提示词的真实性、效率和实际作用存在不同看法。同时，部分讨论集中于工具使用引发的隐私问题及模型在具体任务中的表现。

data.title: Reverse-engineering Fujitsu M7MU RELC hardware compression
data.author: ge0rg
data.article_summary: 本文详细记录了对三星NX mini等相机固件中使用的富士通RELC硬件压缩算法的逆向工程过程。目标是提取并反汇编固件中的ARM代码，但最终确认该算法为富士通的RELC（Rapid Embedded Lossless data Compression），广泛用于其ARM SoC中的硬件IP模块。文章分步骤解析了LZSS压缩算法的识别和分析过程，包括.bin文件的分层结构、压缩数据块和标记的解析等。通过分析不同section文件中的调试字符串，发现每个文件单独压缩。文章还解释了LZSS压缩的基本原理，包括字节级滑动窗口、位掩码及如何处理字面量和引用。最终，作者总结了研究结果并提供了相关工具和文档。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：关于富士通RELC（Reliability Enhancement Lifecycle）及其专有算法的讨论

不同观点：
• **对专有算法的支持观点**：有人可能认为使用专有算法可以为富士通RELC提供独特的优势。专有算法通常经过专门设计，以解决特定问题或在某些任务中表现更好。支持者可能会强调这种算法的独特性和专有技术带来的竞争优势，尤其是在提升产品可靠性和性能方面。例如，这类算法可能在数据处理速度、准确性或适应特定业务需求上有显著优势。

This is a follow-up to the
Samsung NX mini (M7MU) firmware reverse-engineering
series. This part is about the proprietary LZSS compression used for the code
sections in the firmware of Samsung NX mini, NX3000/NX3300 and Galaxy K Zoom.
The post is documenting the step-by-step discovery process, in order to show
how an unknown compression algorithm can be analyzed. The discovery process was
supported by
Igor Skochinsky
and
Tedd Sterr, and by writing the ideas out on
encode.su
.
The initial goal was to understand just enough of the algorithm to extract and
disassemble the ARM code for (de)compression. Unfortunately, this turned out
as impossible when, after the algorithm was already mostly demystified, Igor
identified it as
Fujitsu's RELC (Rapid Embedded Lossless data Compression)
,
an embedded hardware IP block on their ARM SoCs.
The TL;DR results of this research can be found in the project wiki:
M7MU Compression
.
Layer 1: the .bin file
Layer 2: the sections
LZSS compression primer
Layer 4: the blocks
Layer 5: the tokens
Variable length tokens
How long is the length? YES!
Back to layer 3: the subsections
Subsection sizes after decompression
Plain-text subsections
Fujitsu RELC history
Summary
Layer 1: the
.bin
file
Part 1
identified the
.bin
files that
can be analyzed, derived the container format and created an
extraction tool
for the section files within a firmware container.
The analysis in this post is based on the
chunk-05.bin
section file
extracted from the NX mini firmware version 1.10:
5301868 Apr  8 16:57 chunk-01.bin
1726853 Apr  8 16:57 chunk-02.bin
16 Apr  8 16:57 chunk-03.bin
400660 Apr  8 16:57 chunk-04.bin
4098518 Apr  8 16:57 chunk-05.bin
16 Apr  8 16:57 chunk-06.bin
16 Apr  8 16:57 chunk-07.bin
Layer 2: the sections
The seven section files are between 16 bytes and 5.2MB, the larger ones
definitively contain compressed data (
strings
output yields incomplete /
split results, especially on longer strings like copyright notices):
<chunk-01.bin>
Copyright (C) ^A^T^@^F, Arcsoft Inc<88>
<chunk-02.bin>
Copyright^@^@ (c) 2000-2010 b^@<95>y FotoNa^QT. ^@<87> ^B's^QÃ±^A1erved.
<chunk-05.bin>
Copyright (c) 2<80>^@^@5-2011, Jouni Ma^@^@linen <*@**.**>
^@^@and contributors^@^B^@This program ^@^Kf^@^@ree software. Yo!
u ^@q dis^C4e it^AF/^@<9c>m^D^@odify^@^Q
under theA^@ P+ms of^B^MGNU Gene^A^@ral Pub^@<bc> License^D^E versPy 2.
The wpa_supplicant license inside
chunk-05.bin
indicates that it's the
network / browser / image upload code, which I need to understand in order to
fix
NX mini support in my Samsung API reimplementation
.
Given how compression algorithms replace repeating patterns from the input
with references, we can expect the data at the beginning of a compressed file
to have fewer references and thus be easier to understand.
Ideally, we need to find some compressed data for which we know the precise
uncompressed plain-text, in order to correlate which parts of the stream are
literals and which parts are references.
The sections 1, 2, 4 and 5 all contain debug strings close to their respective
beginning. This indicates that each section file is compressed individually,
an important preliminary insight. However, some of the debug strings have
spelling issues, and searching for them on the internet doesn't give us any
plain-text reference:
-- Myri^@^@ad --makememlog.^@^@txt is not exist ^@
^@^@^AOpDebugMemIni ^@t ^@+roy alloc OK
^@^H^@Â´Â¢Ã©AÃ¨@0A--[^CT] H^@^@EAP_ALLOC_TOTAL=^A^@%u
LZSS compression primer
The pattern visible in long strings, where the string is interrupted by two
zero bytes after 16 characters, was quickly identified as a variant of
LZSS
by Igor. I hadn't encountered that before, and still had traumatic memories
from variable bit-length Huffman encodings which I deemed impossible to
analyze.
Luckily, LZSS operates on whole bytes and is rather straightforward to
understand and to implement.  The "Sliding window compression" section of
Unpacking HP Firmware Updates
does a decent job of explaining it on a practical example.
Each
block
in the compressed stream begins with a bitmask, identifying which
of the following bytes are
literals
that need to be directly inserted into
the output stream, and which ones are
tokens
, representing a lookup into the
previously decompressed data. To limit the required memory use, the
decompressed data is limited to a fixed size
window
of some kilobytes. Each
token is a tuple of
offset
(how far back the referenced data is from the end
of the window) and
length
(how many bytes to copy).
The number of bits used to encode the bitmask, the offset, and the length in

data.title: My Dream Thermostat
data.author: leontrolski
data.article_summary: 本文描述了作者理想中的恒温器。他们希望这种设备能够更智能、更人性化，自动根据用户的生活习惯和偏好调节温度，而无需手动干预。此外，作者期待它能与其他智能家居设备无缝连接，提供更全面的居家体验。同时，它还应具备节能功能，帮助节省电费。总的来说，作者希望未来的恒温器能够在便利性、智能化和节能方面有显著提升。
data.comments_summary:
主要讨论点：智能和传统恒温器的功能与用户需求

不同观点：
• **自定义复杂行为的支持**：biotinker分享了在俄勒冈州特定气候条件下，自定义的一套复杂的恒温器规则，强调没有通用解决方案能完全满足个人需求，建议使用像Home Assistant这样的工具来自定义控制。

• **简单UI与复杂功能的对比**：singpolyma3认为简单用户界面（UI）能满足大多数人的需求，批评那些追求复杂智能设备的人忽略了核心功能。behnamoh以幽默方式回应了对简单UI的期望。

• **自动切换冷暖模式的需求**：cstrahan提到现有恒温器无法自动在制冷和制热之间切换，导致温度管理不便，尤其是在气候多变的地区（如德州）。

• **自制恒温器的可行性**：barnas2和bhaney认为自制恒温器是可行的，尤其是使用Raspberry Pi或ESP-32等微控制器，可以实现高度自定义的功能。

• **现有产品的局限性与改进建议**：Ecco赞赏亚马逊智能恒温器的硬件设计，但对其缺乏本地控制功能表示失望，并希望有人能解锁其固件。MostlyStable则寻找一种能兼顾基本功能和复杂自动化控制的商用恒温器。

• **传统与智能的对比**：kimixa提到英国的传统恒温器已经具备基本定时和控制功能，质疑是否需要最新智能恒温器。herpdyderp则选择将Nest恒温器当作非智能设备使用。

• **其他智能家居功能的期望**：bironran希望有更灵活的报警系统，而matthewdgreen则期望有计算机控制的阀门来防止管道冻裂。

补充讨论：
• **对智能设备复杂性的不同态度**：部分用户如behnamoh和singpolyma3偏好简单直观的功能，而另一些用户如biotinker、barnas2和bhaney则享受通过技术手段自定义复杂规则的乐趣。

• **具体功能需求的地域性差异**：例如，biotinker的需求受到俄勒冈州气候影响，而cstrahan的评论反映了德州气候多变地区的困扰。

争议焦点：智能恒温器是否需要复杂的自定义功能，还是应该专注于提供简单可靠的基本控制。

data.title: Tulsi Gabbard Reused the Same Weak Password on Multiple Accounts for Years
data.author: zzzeek
data.article_summary: Tulsi Gabbard, the director of national intelligence, used the same easily guessable password for multiple online accounts over several years, raising concerns about her cybersecurity practices. Leaked records reviewed by WIRED show Gabbard used the password "shraddha" for various accounts, including Gmail, Dropbox, and LinkedIn, despite it being contrary to security best practices. The password has personal significance, linked to her reported involvement with the Science of Identity Foundation, which former members have accused of being a cult. Gabbard's team denies any affiliation with the group and calls accusations of her being in a cult "bigoted." Cybersecurity experts warn against reusing passwords, as it increases the risk of multiple accounts being compromised. Gabbard, overseeing 18 intelligence organizations and a $100 billion budget, is responsible for some of the government's most sensitive information.

43911061.article_content:

Tulsi Gabbard, the
director of national intelligence, used the same easily cracked
password
for different online accounts over a period of years, according to leaked records reviewed by WIRED. Following her participation in a
Signal group chat
in which sensitive details of a military operation were unwittingly shared with a journalist, the revelation raises further questions about the security practices of the US spy chief.
WIRED reviewed Gabbard's passwords using databases of material leaked online created by the open-source intelligence firms District4Labs and Constella Intelligence. Gabbard served in Congress from 2013 to 2021, during which time she sat on the Armed Services Committee, its Subcommittee on Intelligence and Special Operations, and the Foreign Affairs Committee, giving her access to sensitive information. Material from breaches shows that during a portion of this period, she used the same password across multiple email addresses and online accounts, in contravention of well-established
best practices
for online security. (There is no indication that she used the password on government accounts.)
Two collections of breached records published in 2017 (but breached at some previous unknown date), known as “combolists,” reveal a password that was used for an email account associated with her
personal website
; that same password, according to a combolist published in 2019, was used with her Gmail account. That same password was used, according to records dating to 2012, for Dropbox and LinkedIn accounts associated with the email address tied to her personal website. According to records dating to 2018 breaches, she also used it on a MyFitnessPal account associated with a me.com email address and an account at HauteLook, a now-defunct ecommerce site then owned by Nordstrom.
Records of these breaches have been available online for years and are accessible in commercial databases.
The password associated with all of the accounts in question includes the word “shraddha,” which appears to have personal significance to Gabbard: Earlier this year, The Wall Street Journal
reported
that she had been initiated into the Science of Identity Foundation, an offshoot of the Hare Krishna movement into which she was
reportedly
born and which former members have accused of being a cult. Several former adherents told The Journal that they believe Gabbard received the name “Shraddha Dasi” when she was allegedly received into the group. Gabbard’s deputy chief of staff, Alexa Henning, responded to questions from The Journal at the time by
posting them on X
and accusing the news media of publicizing “Hinduphobic smears and other lies.”
“The data breaches you’re referring to occurred almost 10 years ago, and the passwords have changed multiple times since,” wrote Olivia Coleman, a Gabbard spokesperson, in response to questions from WIRED. “As our deputy chief of staff has already made clear on a number of occasions, the DNI has never and doesn’t have affiliation with that organization. Attempting to smear the DNI as being in a cult is bigoted behavior.“
“Your bigoted lies and smears of a cabinet member and your story fomenting hinduphobia is noted,” wrote Henning in response to a follow-up question about the probability of Gabbard’s password containing the same name she was reportedly received into Science of Identity Foundation with, given her denials that she has ever been affiliated with the group. “This was well litigated during her confirmation hearing so congrats on being about 6 months late to this story. Great job.”
Science of Identity did not respond to a request for comment.
Security experts advise people to never use the same password on different accounts precisely because people often do so. If a password for one account is revealed in a breach, hackers will often attempt to use it to access other accounts controlled by the same person. Reusing passwords is especially dangerous with email, because a compromised email account can be used to reset credentials for other accounts or systems.
The Cybersecurity Infrastructure and Security Agency, the top US government authority on digital security,
advises
members of the public to use a
password manager
to generate a different password of at least 16 characters, consisting of random strings of mixed-case numbers, letters, and symbols or at least four unrelated words, for every account they use.
As director of national intelligence, Gabbard oversees the
18 organizations
comprising the US intelligence community, including the Central Intelligence Agency and the National Security Agency, and their budget of roughly
$100 billion
. By
statute
, she is the principal adviser to the president and the National Security Council on intelligence matters relating to national security, and so is charged with maintaining the security of much of the most sensitive information in the government. The Democratic National Committee,

Top row: original images. Second row: images reconstructed by AI based on brain recordings from a macaque. Bottom row: images reconstructed by the AI system without an attention mechanism

主要讨论点：对信息操控、舆论引导及社交媒体“蜂群”行为的分析与反思

不同观点：
• 第一种观点：alganet认为，美国当前的政府如果发布类似的简短报告，可能会因为其政治立场而失去公信力。这暗示了公众对信息来源和发布者政治倾向的敏感性，以及可能对信息真实性和动机产生的怀疑。

• 第二种观点：alganet指出，自2010年甚至更早以来，社交媒体上的“蜂群”行为和休眠账户就已经存在。这表明社交媒体上的舆论操控和有组织的群体行为并非新现象，而是长期存在的。

• 第三种观点：alganet建议，相关机构应制定更全面的应对策略，了解这些舆论操控手段如何运作、被谁使用，以及可能如何转变。这强调了对信息战和舆论操控进行深入研究和监测的必要性。

• 第四种观点：alganet将高度两极分化的讨论主题比作“群体性心因性疾病”或“集体性歇斯底里”，认为这些讨论最终会影响普通人的叙事方式。这暗示了公众在面对高度情绪化和政治化的信息时，容易受到影响和操控。

• 第五种观点：alganet提出，不应将这种现象仅限于特定的标签或名称（如Codename-123），甚至戏称为“Skynet”，而是应认识到这些讨论本质上是互联的，任何对此类话题的贡献都会助长“蜂群”效应，无论其政治倾向如何。这指出了舆论操控的复杂性和不可控性。

补充讨论：
• alganet最后建议，应该采取另一种方式，即通过教育公众，让他们了解正在发生的事情，从而抵御这些操控行为。这表明了对信息透明度和公众知情权的重要性的认识。

争议焦点：
• 争议的焦点在于如何有效应对和抵御社交媒体上的舆论操控和“蜂群”行为。一方认为应通过深入研究和监测来制定策略，另一方则主张通过教育公众来增强其辨别和抵御能力。

TL;DR总结：alganet认为，无法单独关闭对方的“蜂群”而不影响自己的舆论，因为它们是互联的，必须通过教育和信息透明来共同应对。
